jobs.title: Employee Engagement Program Manager
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco/San Jose/Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

We’ve built a lot of great resources for employees: onboarding guides, benefits pages, manager how-tos, and hiring FAQs. But we move faster than we document and maintain. We’re growing quickly. Things get out of date, hard to find, or inconsistent in tone. We need someone to own that problem end to end and make sure every piece of employee-facing content is accurate, easy to find, and sounds like it came from the same team.

This isn’t a pure technical writing role, and it isn’t a traditional program management role either. It’s both. You’ll write, design, and edit, but you’ll also audit, organize, and measure. If you like bringing order to scattered information and quietly making everyone’s job a little easier (maybe even delightful), this is your gig.

**What You’ll Do**

* Audit employee-facing pages, websites, FAQs, guides, and policies.
* Write and edit onboarding guides, templates, FAQs, and how-tos.
* Set consistent tone, voice, and format across content.
* Organize content so employees can find answers.
* Fix pages and processes when something isn't working.
* Track usage and feedback to see what’s working and what isn’t.
* Coordinate with HR, Talent, on shared content.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3 to 5 years in writing, content, or program coordination.
* Strong, clear, creative writing and editing skills.
* Comfort building style guides and content standards.
* A sharp eye for content that’s outdated or hard to find.
* Comfort tracking metrics like page views, clicks, comments, reactions.
* Nice to have: experience with Notion, Confluence, Wikis.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

You’ll have a front-row seat to the growth of a company shaping the future of tech, and you’ll have a direct hand in making that growth possible. We value speed, tenacity, creativity, and being excellent to each other. You’ll be a part of the Employee Engagement team. Our goal is simple: to be the most helpful team at Lambda. If you want a seat where you can make a huge impact every day and turn chaos into clarity, this is it.

**Salary Range Information**

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

**About Lambda**

* Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
* Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
* We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
* Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
* We offer generous cash & equity compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
* 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
* Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

Compensation Range: $135K - $180K

jobs.title: Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250
jobs.description:
Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Graduate Funding Unit plays a central role in maintaining the highest level of academic excellence possible at UC Berkeley. We provide fellowships, funding, and program support to attract the most competitive students to our university and provide funding opportunities for students at various stages of their academic career. Our programs exist to give students opportunities to devote themselves fully to the pursuit of their scholarly and professional interests. Our knowledge and expertise in all areas of graduate funding and student life provide a strong foundation for advising the students, faculty, and staff across our vast and diverse campus.
  
  
The Student Funding team trains and advises staff and faculty departmental advisors in over 125 degree programs, offers direct advising to approximately 13,000 graduate and professional students, as well as individuals seeking admission into a graduate program at Berkeley. Training and expertise includes fellowship and academic support funding and collective bargaining agreement administration for academic student employees and graduate student researchers.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Fellowships Program Coordinator plays a significant role in supporting graduate students through the administration of Graduate Division, Campus, National, and International fellowship programs on behalf of the campus. This position works with internal and external organizations to coordinate graduate student fellowships, providing support to students, faculty, and staff from application to evaluation to awarding. The Fellowships Program Coordinator serves as an expert resource to update formulas and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies, ensuring proper payment of awards and monitoring compliance with fellowship terms. Additionally, this position administers and tracks the current University Fellowship allocation system, analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery, and partners with departmental staff to provide accurate and transparent information about funding to help students achieve their academic goals.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 19, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Fellowship Program Administration - 30%
  
  
Implements and coordinates graduate student fellowship programs administered by the Graduate Division.
  
Works with internal and external organizations to coordinate procedures.
  
Serves as expert resource to update applications and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies.
  
Analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery.
  
  
NSF GRFP Administration - 30%
  
  
Serves as campus-wide expert and steward of National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program (NSF GRFP).
  
Acts as student facing Coordinating Official, working with fellows, faculty, and staff to provide information, respond to inquiries about program policies, and interface with the NSF.
  
Interprets regulations and develops or recommends procedures to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery.
  
Reconciles large volumes of student data from multiple sources and adjusts Grants Roster Report. Coordinates yearly NSF GRFP info session.
  
Updates NSF GRFP Administration at UCB guide.
  
Works with fellows, GSAOs, and Berkeley Regional Services to ensure correct assessment and funding source.
  
  
Travel Grant Administration - 10%
  
  
Reviews Slate fellowship application data to administer the Graduate Division's Conference Travel Grant program.
  
Monitors, tracks, and makes awards in Campus Solutions.
  
Tracks budget and provides analysis of usage and suggestions on how to improve the process.
  
Provides individual counseling on non-routine, sensitive aid issues.
  
Exercises professional judgment to authorize changes in financial aid awards.
  
  
Fellowship and Block Grant Allocations - 10%
  
  
Provides annual Berkeley and Chancellor's Fellowship allocation information to divisional leadership and tracks their departmental allocations.
  
Monitors and tracks Chancellor's carry forward and other exceptions.
  
Delivers annual Block Grant memos to programs.
  
Memos provide yearly allocation amounts as well as Graduate Opportunity Program, Mentored Research Award, and UC Dissertation Year nomination amounts.
  
Recommends new or changes to policy in areas needing clarification, and supports the Director of Student Funding to identify solutions to existing fellowship program policies without precedent.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployments (Life Sciences- Community & Enablement)
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About Beneficial Deployments**
--------------------------------

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team, focused on helping scientists everywhere get the most from Claude, especially Claude Science. You'll run enablements, workshops and hackathons, build demos that show what frontier models can do for the field, and grow a community of scientists building with Claude. You'll also scale scientific enablement inside Anthropic, so our Applied AI and customer teams can support scientists without you in the room.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Be the DRI for scientific enablement: decide what to run, build the materials, deliver them, and measure whether research teams reach daily use of Claude.
* Lead our programs for activating scientists at scale, such as LSVP and Claude for Researchers: set the goals, design the program and run it.
* Build demos, notebooks and tutorials that show scientists what frontier models can do in their own work, and be an active voice where scientists share tools online (X, LinkedIn, etc.).
* Scale scientific enablement inside Anthropic: train our Applied AI and Customer Success teams, and build playbooks they can run without you.
* Build and lead a scientist community around Claude, and be its ambassador (and support ambassador programs), from small meetups to large conferences.
* Be the voice of scientists inside Anthropic: turn what you hear into concrete asks and see them through to launch, and partner with Marketing and Comms so campaigns and content reach the scientific community.

**You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have**
---------------------------------------

* Deep hands-on expertise with AI tools for science such as Claude Science: you know where they shine and where they break.
* Real credibility as a scientist: hands-on experience doing science in academic labs, biotechs, pharma or research institutes, ideally as a user of the kind of tools you'll help scientists adopt. Experience building or running programs for scientific communities is a plus.
* A track record of helping many scientific teams adopt a new tool through demos, trainings, workshops or hackathons.
* Up to date on AI for science, such as agentic analysis and AI co-scientists, and able to explain it to working scientists.
* Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you can prototype a working demo. You don't need to write production code.
* Clear written and spoken communication: talks, tutorials and docs that scientists find useful.
* A track record of taking programs or products from idea to results: you set the direction, did the work and were accountable for the outcome, often with no playbook.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$275,000 - $315,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

jobs.title: Staff Customer Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Staff Customer Operations Manager, you will lead Crusoe's customer feedback ecosystem and use it to shape strategy and operations. You will unify customer and market signals, build a comprehensive view of our customer base, monitor the competitive landscape, and deliver evidence-backed recommendations to executive leadership.

This role connects intelligence to business outcomes. You will track how AI models are evolving and what those shifts mean for GPU demand and our Managed Intelligence offerings, prepare executive customer updates for Cloud Leadership, bring customer evidence into Product and Engineering planning, and build the business case for where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Design and scale the systems that capture, triage, and route customer feedback, including the taxonomy, quality standards, and a central repository of customer evidence
* Own executive update cadences for Cloud Leadership, including the quarterly Voice of Customer executive briefing and Monthly Business Reviews, tracking wins, customer experience signals, and operational updates across the CX team
* Identify where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience based on customer demand, market analysis, and cost to serve
* Advocate for customers in Product and Engineering planning with evidence-based insights, and track the lifecycle of each request from intake through prioritization, delivery, and adoption
* Build the business case for new service offerings and lead their incubation through launch
* Support go-to-market teams with account reviews, customer-specific analysis, and targeted research
* Maintain a comprehensive view of Crusoe's customers, covering segmentation, adoption, and infrastructure footprint, and flag risks such as churn, along with expansion opportunities and behavioral shifts, to account teams
* Monitor competing GPU cloud and inference platforms, including product releases, pricing, and service commitments
* Track AI models across their lifecycle, from frontier and open-weight releases through fine-tuning, serving, and retirement, and map which models and workloads customers train and serve on Crusoe
* Explain what model shifts, such as new architectures, longer context windows, lower-precision formats, and new inference engines, mean for GPU demand, Managed Inference offerings, and account risk

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8+ years in customer operations, Voice of Customer, CX or product strategy, or consulting, translating customer feedback into operational changes
* Technical fluency in AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, or developer tooling, with the ability to read technical documentation, support tickets, and release notes
* Ability to separate true technical differentiation from marketing claims
* Strong executive writing skills for memos, briefs, and recommendations
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority
* Comfortable building operating frameworks and processes in ambiguous environments
* Hands-on experience prototyping and operationalizing workflows with AI tools
* Experience at an AI lab, GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or inference platform
* Background in building competitive intelligence or Voice of Customer programs
* Skill in translating technical insights into a business case

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 - $190,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Staff Customer Operations Manager, you will lead Crusoe's customer feedback ecosystem and use it to shape strategy and operations. You will unify customer and market signals, build a comprehensive view of our customer base, monitor the competitive landscape, and deliver evidence-backed recommendations to executive leadership.

This role connects intelligence to business outcomes. You will track how AI models are evolving and what those shifts mean for GPU demand and our Managed Intelligence offerings, prepare executive customer updates for Cloud Leadership, bring customer evidence into Product and Engineering planning, and build the business case for where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Design and scale the systems that capture, triage, and route customer feedback, including the taxonomy, quality standards, and a central repository of customer evidence
* Own executive update cadences for Cloud Leadership, including the quarterly Voice of Customer executive briefing and Monthly Business Reviews, tracking wins, customer experience signals, and operational updates across the CX team
* Identify where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience based on customer demand, market analysis, and cost to serve
* Advocate for customers in Product and Engineering planning with evidence-based insights, and track the lifecycle of each request from intake through prioritization, delivery, and adoption
* Build the business case for new service offerings and lead their incubation through launch
* Support go-to-market teams with account reviews, customer-specific analysis, and targeted research
* Maintain a comprehensive view of Crusoe's customers, covering segmentation, adoption, and infrastructure footprint, and flag risks such as churn, along with expansion opportunities and behavioral shifts, to account teams
* Monitor competing GPU cloud and inference platforms, including product releases, pricing, and service commitments
* Track AI models across their lifecycle, from frontier and open-weight releases through fine-tuning, serving, and retirement, and map which models and workloads customers train and serve on Crusoe
* Explain what model shifts, such as new architectures, longer context windows, lower-precision formats, and new inference engines, mean for GPU demand, Managed Inference offerings, and account risk

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8+ years in customer operations, Voice of Customer, CX or product strategy, or consulting, translating customer feedback into operational changes
* Technical fluency in AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, or developer tooling, with the ability to read technical documentation, support tickets, and release notes
* Ability to separate true technical differentiation from marketing claims
* Strong executive writing skills for memos, briefs, and recommendations
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority
* Comfortable building operating frameworks and processes in ambiguous environments
* Hands-on experience prototyping and operationalizing workflows with AI tools
* Experience at an AI lab, GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or inference platform
* Background in building competitive intelligence or Voice of Customer programs
* Skill in translating technical insights into a business case

**Benefits:**

* Employer contributions to HSA account

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 - $190,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Talent Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Re:Build**
------------------

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)*

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

Re:Build seeks a hands-on Recruiting Operations Manager to architect and build our AI-enabled talent acquisition function. **Your most important qualification is expert-level experience deploying reliable AI workflows that deliver measurable results, not just using AI tools or creating demonstrations.**

We have budget, internal resources, and support from our Digital Innovation Group. Our technology environment includes but does not have to be limited to **Greenhouse ATS, Clay, LinkedIn Recruiter, Textio, and Criteria.**

**What you get to do**
----------------------

* **AI architecture and delivery:** Own the roadmap from workflow design and prototyping through deployment, adoption, and improvement. Determine when to configure, integrate, buy, or build.
* **Conversational AI:** Deploy hiring-team and candidate-facing agents for requisition intake, process guidance, scheduling, and updates, with authorized system actions and human handoffs.
* **Recruiting infrastructure:** Own system configuration, integrations, data quality, documentation, and vendor performance; reduce administrative work and unnecessary tools.
* **Analytics and planning:** Partner with Finance on workforce planning. Track on-time hiring against fill dates set at requisition opening, recruiter capacity, user experience, costs, and AI impact.
* **Team enablement:** Partner with recruiters, hiring leaders, Digital Innovation, and IT to build practical AI capabilities and turn prototypes into adopted, supported workflows.
* **Responsible deployment:** Establish testing, monitoring, access controls, data protection, accessibility, and fairness safeguards, preserving human accountability for hiring decisions.

**What you bring to the Team**
------------------------------

* Personally delivered multiple AI-enabled workflows into sustained use, including recruiting applications, with measurable results.
* Production experience with conversational agents, trusted knowledge sources, connected systems, multi-step tasks, and human escalation.
* Hands-on fluency with APIs, webhooks, structured data, automation platforms, and AI-assisted development; able to build independently and guide technical partners.
* Strong recruiting operations, analytics, and change-management expertise, with the judgment to distinguish technology needs from process or capacity issues.

**Experience that would be especially valuable**
------------------------------------------------

Experience with our tools, manufacturing, engineering, skilled-trades, or multi-business recruiting is valuable. Exact-tool experience does not replace demonstrated AI implementation expertise.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Less administrative work, better hiring-team and candidate experiences, stronger workforce visibility, and measurable gains in speed, quality, service, and cost, with reliable solutions people use.

**How we will assess your experience**
--------------------------------------

Be prepared to discuss two production deployments: what you personally built, reliability and adoption, measurable impact, and lessons learned. Demonstrated delivery matters more than years using a particular AI product.

  

Compensation (Exempt)

The base salary range for this position is $160k - $190k per year. This range represents the Company's good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

**The BIG payoff**

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

**We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate**

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

On the Merchant Strategy & Operations team, our mission is to have best-in-class restaurant selection for Consumers and build products and services for our Merchants to grow their businesses profitably on DoorDash. We work on problems ranging from acquiring and onboarding new merchants to building a positive experience and solving pain points for existing merchants, to growing their sales through new products and services.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Merchant Strategy & Operations Associate Manager at DoorDash, you will lead the support experience for our merchants, owning both the strategy & execution of how we serve them once they're live on the platform. You'll be responsible for transforming support into a tech-first, scalable, and seamless experience that drives merchant satisfaction, retention & loyalty.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Strategize** – Build the strategy for helping merchants succeed once they're live on DoorDash by providing fast and seamless solutions when merchants face issues, minimizing operational friction
* **Experiment, Analyze and Implement** – Use data-driven decision-making and sound business judgment to drive go-to-market & execution for new initiatives to help merchants have the best experience on Doordash
* **Influence** – Work cross-functionally with our product, operations, marketing, sales, finance, and analytics teams to land key initiatives

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have completed your Bachelor's degree and have 4-6 years of experience in consulting, strategy, operations, technology, or related experience
* You want to affect change every day and can operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
* You love thinking about problems from a first principles approach, and are excited to take action, dig into the details, and try new things in order to create future solutions
* You have experience working on analytical projects (proficiency in SQL is a plus) and are eager to get to the lowest level of detail to pull out valuable insights
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills
* You thrive working in a cross-functional environment, and have had success leading projects across teams
* You're comfortable leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, and problem-solving. You should be actively exploring and applying AI in your day-to-day work, bringing a beginner's mindset and curiosity as you continuously learn and adapt alongside evolving technology.

  

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

The Finance & Operations Manager oversees the day-­to-­day financial and administrative operations of Cancer Support Community SF Bay Area. This position is responsible for managing all accounting and banking functions for the organization, and works closely with the Chief Executive Officer to generate and track budgets both for internal purposes and outside funders (in conjunction with the Director of Development). In addition, the Finance & Operations Manager performs administrative duties, human resource coordination, assists with grants preparation, facility oversight and coordination and other duties as assigned.

This is an exempt position that reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*Finance*

* Manage the overall accounting and bookkeeping for the organization including accounts payable and receivable, capital assets, banking, and payroll functions
* Work closely with the CEO and Director of Development to handle revenue for all development initiatives, including but not limited to:
* Creating and monitoring all grant budgets and grant-­‐related financial information
* Processing and tracking all forms of donations; tracking use of restricted funds; producing revenue reports
* Interface with CPA firm to coordinate annual financial audits and oversee all 990 reports
* Facilitate the annual budget process
* Provide monthly financial reporting and analysis of financial statements, including statement of activities, fund balance, and sources/uses of funds, to the CEO and, as requested, to the Board of Directors
* Provide administrative assistance, including oversight of facility vendors and contracts, and establishing and managing vendor accounts and relationships

*Operations*

* Responsible for office management including, but not limited to, telephone and internet services, connecting with building management, managing infrastructure and facility improvements
* Analyze and organize office operations and procedures to increase efficiency and productivity
* Other duties to ensure building operations are running smoothly
* Assist with the onboard and offboard employees and update HR policies and procedures
* Coordinate healthcare and payroll with external benefits administrator
* Assist with coordinating material for Board of Director’s meeting
* Assist the CEO (when needed and requested)

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:**

* A flexible, creative, entrepreneurial spirit
* A demonstrated passion for the mission of CSC
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills
* Proven ability to prepare budgets and donor financial reports
* Excellent interpersonal and networking skills
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Experience working with diverse constituents, teams and colleagues
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Ability to convene and motivate teams, staff members, and volunteers
* Flexibility and creativity in the face of ambiguity and challenge
* Able to take ownership and drive activities to completion
* Proven organizational and project management skills
* Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting or administrative related field
* A minimum of five years of experience in for or nonprofit management, including bookkeeping, financial reporting, payroll, etc.

**ABOUT CSC SF BAY AREA** Cancer Support Community provides comprehensive, integrative care—including counseling, support groups, nutrition training, exercise classes, emergency financial assistance, and patient education programs—for people with cancer, their caregivers, and their families. Our evidence-based services enable cancer patients to partner with their medical teams to manage their treatment and recovery most effectively, increase their chances for survival, reduce their chances of recurrence, and provide for the highest possible quality of life. All CSC services are always provided free of charge and are being offered virtually during the pandemic. With services provided at our Walnut Creek center, in local medical centers throughout the Bay Area, and now in Antioch, we serve more than 2,200 people annually. Visit for more information.

Starting salary commensurate with related work experience and qualifications. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, and generous paid time off.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

I am Sarah Wagner Rayburn, co-founder of Marin Home Team at Compass. We have been serving Marin County clients for over twenty-five years and have built a reputation on deep local knowledge, strong relationships, and attention to detail.

I am looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with me.

This is a hands-on role for someone organized, proactive and tech-comfortable who genuinely enjoys making things run well. You will be the person who keeps the wheels turning so I can focus on what I do best, which is serving clients.

It is not a sit-behind-a-desk-all-day job. Some days you are in the field, checking on listings, making keys, meeting vendors. Other days you are at your computer, managing paperwork, updating systems, building marketing materials. You need to be based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley every day.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**TRANSACTION SUPPORT, WHICH IS THE CORE OF THE ROLE**

You will manage the operational backbone of every deal, from listing or buyer prep through to closing.

LISTINGS. Work with our transaction coordinator to prepare disclosure packages. Coordinate inspections and vendor work. Manage timelines. Handle MLS prep and entry. Develop marketing materials. Coordinate photography and photo selection. Keep everything organized in Compass and our team systems.

BUYERS. Set up new buyer files in Notejoy and Compass Business Tracker. Set up Compass Collections and Top Agent Network searches. Prepare paperwork. Track escrow timelines.

CONTRACTS AND PAPERWORK. Prep offers and other transactional documents. Manage DocuSign and Compass e-sign workflows. Review documents for accuracy. Handle contingency removals and timeline deadlines. Execute referral agreements.

ESCROW. Track deadlines across all active transactions. Anticipate upcoming needs. Coordinate with lenders, title companies and clients.

**LISTING MARKETING**

PROPERTY MARKETING. Write property descriptions and marketing copy, working with me and with AI. Create flyers and brochures using Compass tools. Build and send marketing emails. Update our team website and individual listing sites.

BRAND CONSISTENCY. Keep MarinHome.Team current and cohesive. Maintain Compass collateral and marketing materials. Make sure our brand looks polished at every touchpoint.

**DAILY OPERATIONS**

THE INBOX. Monitor and manage email related to my transactions, plus Slack and text. Field questions and requests. Route things to the right person.

THE CALENDAR. Maintain and update the calendar. Coordinate showing schedules. Schedule vendor appointments. Track inspection and timeline deadlines.

CRM AND DATABASE. Manage Compass Contact Management. Track client relationships, update contact records, manage my buyer and seller pipelines, track sales data for reporting.

INFORMATION MANAGEMENT. Maintain our Notejoy workspace: buyer profiles, vendor lists, listing details, templates, passwords. Create and update shared documents. Keep everything organized and findable.

**TECH AND AI**

Explore parts of the Compass platform we are not using, or could be using better, and bring back what would actually help. Work with me on building AI tools that make the business run more efficiently.

This is a real part of the job, not a nice-to-have. We use AI daily for writing, organizing and streamlining, and I am actively building more of it.

**IN THE FIELD**

BOOTS ON THE GROUND. Check on listings for lights, lockboxes and signage. Meet vendors and inspectors on site. Pick up and make keys. Coordinate staging logistics. Handle broker tour catering and setup.

CLIENT-FACING MOMENTS. You may deal with clients by phone or in person. You will need to be warm, professional and comfortable representing the Marin Home Team.

VENDORS. Schedule inspectors, stagers, photographers and contractors. Manage quotes and project timelines. Maintain our vendor list.

**ADMIN**

EXPENSES. Add my expenses to the team tracker, pay invoices, keep the records straight.

SUBSCRIPTIONS AND TOOLS. Manage operational subscriptions such as the website, Dropbox and Zoom. Troubleshoot tech issues. Research new tools.

INDUSTRY. Attend Compass meetings and industry events as needed, take notes, keep me informed.

REPORTING. Enter new listings and buyer activity in our business tracker. Monitor Top Agent. Network for inventory and opportunities.

**THE FIRST SIX WEEKS**

My days are genuinely different from one another, and real estate does not run to a tidy schedule. So rather than pretend I know exactly which hours I will need you and get it wrong, the first six weeks are a working trial for both of us.

Part of your job in those six weeks is helping me work out what the rhythm actually is. Which days, which hours, what gets batched, what has to happen live. At the end of it we lock in a schedule that reflects reality, and you will know what you are agreeing to because you helped build it.

If it is not right for either of us at that point, we shake hands and part on good terms.

**WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR:**

THE ESSENTIALS

* You are organized in a way other people notice and appreciate
* You are a problem solver who anticipates what is needed before being asked
* You are comfortable with technology and pick up new tools quickly
* You communicate clearly, professionally and warmly
* You can work independently and manage your own time
* You are based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley daily. This role needs you physically present here on a regular basis
* You have strong computer skills: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Claude, and a willingness to learn whatever else comes

NICE TO HAVE

* Previous experience in real estate operations, or somewhere similarly client-facing and
* detail-heavy
* Comfort with CRM systems. Compass experience is a bonus and not a requirement
* Marketing or design skills
* Social media experience
* Experience with DocuSign, Dropbox, Slack or other project manageme

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position:**

Intuitive’s Digital organization aims to improve patient care and empower care teams with unique data and insights from our integrated digital ecosystem. Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products and sustaining existing capabilities to our customers and partners.

The role requires a seasoned program delivery leader who combines rigorous project management discipline with the technical fluency needed to manage infrastructure-intensive digital programs in a regulated enterprise environment. This individual will serve as the primary program management accountable party for a portfolio of Digital initiatives spanning software product delivery, cloud infrastructure build-out, platform engineering, and operational readiness—ensuring each program is delivered on scope, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with applicable quality and regulatory standards. The ideal candidate brings deep experience managing complex, multi-workstream programs where infrastructure dependencies — including cloud environment configuration, network architecture, DevOps pipeline maturity, and security and compliance controls — are first-class program concerns rather than afterthoughts.

At Intuitive, Program Management is not a task-based job. We are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. **About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." UX Programs & Operations drives projects by increasing communication, streamlining the UX design process, and fostering a culture of user-centered development. You will harmonize the work of various UX disciplines and cross-functional partners to drive team objectives and create innovative experiences.

Cloud AI UX designs how enterprises build, govern, and trust AI agents. Define windows for enterprise AI, and the experiences we ship now will shape how businesses work for years. In this role, you will run the programs that let our design team ship coherent, high-quality work on Agent Platform and beyond, the surfaces where enterprise customers build, configure, and govern AI agents. You bring strong portfolio management, a real feel for UX quality, and the collaboration instincts to keep design, product, and engineering moving in the same direction.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?  
  
Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

We are building intelligent systems that bring generative AI into the physical world - merging models, embodiment, and real-time perception into entirely new product experiences. As a Data Program Manager are responsible for all aspects of data acquisition for the next generation of AI products by working on cross-functional DAI (data and artificial intelligence) data programs that support Siemens’ AI and industrial AI initiatives. Here you will partner with applied science, product, engineering, and operations to design and implement pragmatic solutions for acquiring data. You will be a key interface between our product roadmap and external data offerings.  
  
The role will own multiple related workstreams and serve as a liaison across Product, Engineering, Applied Science, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and external data partners. The Data Program Manager will translate business and product needs into executable data programs, establish operating mechanisms, manage dependencies and risks, and drive programs through delivery.

**Key responsibilities****:**

* Manage complex, cross-functional AI data programs and interconnected workstreams from planning through delivery, aligning evolving requirements with clear objectives, milestones, and operating plans.

* Drive execution across Product, Engineering, Applied Science, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, Security, and other stakeholders, while representing programs in leadership forums.

* Oversee end-to-end data acquisition, annotation, curation, licensing, and readiness, and manage strategic day-to-day relationships with internal and external data owners

* Establish success metrics, requirements, and acceptance criteria for data deliverables to measure progress, quality, readiness, and compliance with organizational policies.

* Identify systemic risks, resolve complex cross-organizational dependencies, and lead regular program reviews to communicate status and decisions to senior leadership.

* Manage budgets, resource planning, and vendor commitments while developing scalable governance models, templates, and operating processes to improve program efficiency.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 4+ years of experience in program management, project management, operations, technology programs, data programs, or a related field.

* Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs.

* Experience managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, stakeholders, and external partners.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including communication with senior stakeholders.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing AI, data, software, or technology programs.

* Experience with data acquisition, data annotation, data curation, or data lifecycle programs.

* Experience developing and executing data acquisition strategies that leverage frontier AI models for data discovery, generation, enrichment, transformation, and quality evaluation, with an understanding of when to apply AI-driven approaches versus traditional or human-in-the-loop methods.

* Familiarity with data governance, data privacy, licensing, or responsible AI principles.

* Experience managing strategic vendors or external data providers.

* Experience establishing program governance, operating mechanisms, or standardized processes.

**The application window is expected to close on:** 10/29/2026
  
Meet the Team
  
  
Product Operations Central (Process and Business Intelligence) is a core component of the Product Operations team, providing a centralized hub of multi-disciplinary expertise that fortifies the strategic and operational framework for Business Units (BUs) across Cisco’s product portfolio. This team acts as a strategic partner, collaborating with cross-functional leaders to define Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) strategies, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation across NPI, sustaining, and end-to-end supply chain processes.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
In this role, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our future by proactively collaborating with peers, senior leaders, and functional SMEs. You will bridge the gap between complex PLM business processes and advanced data-driven insights. By implementing innovative analytical solutions, you will ensure our operational framework is both scalable and highly effective.
  
  
As part of this role, you will drive the strategic vision for Business Intelligence (BI) by leading the strategy and execution of initiatives that improve process improvement and foster data-driven decision-making across the product portfolio. You will lead and influence cross-functional collaboration by orchestrating efforts among Product Operations, Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO), Technology& Quality (T), and Engineering teams, unifying these groups under shared data objectives. Your expertise in sophisticated analytics and data integrity will be critical as you define and automate quality frameworks to ensure high-fidelity data, performing deep-dive analyses into product health, development velocity, and operational KPIs.
  
Leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP) tools such as BigQuery and Cloud Composer, you will enable scalable data processing and utilize Google Workspace for collaborative policy management and cross-functional project tracking. You will also play a key role in risk management and mitigation by navigating operational risks through collaborative engagement and developing data-backed mitigation strategies integrated into our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) business processes.
  
  
Operational optimization is another core responsibility, where you will use design-thinking sessions within our business sensing framework to understand business unit challenges and ensure analytical solutions are perfectly aligned with business goals.
  
  
This role drives significant business impact by aligning the organization toward a unified, data-driven PLM strategy that accelerates velocity across New Product Introduction (NPI) and sustaining phases. It harnesses scalable intelligence through GCP infrastructure to transform large datasets into real-time operational insights, improves operational efficiency by automating data quality and BI solutions to reduce manual processes, and supports risk mitigation by equipping leadership with analytical tools to identify and address supply chain and product lifecycle risks proactively.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Information Systems, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in PLM, NPI/Sustaining, HW development, and end-to-end supply chain engineering.
* 5 + years of program management experience leading cross functional teams in complex environments with layered dependencies.
* Expert proficiency in SQL, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Proven experience with Google Cloud platform or similar for data visualization.

Preferred skills
  
  

* Experience in Python or R for advanced statistical analysis.
* Familiarity with Data Governance/Quality tools (e.g., Alation, Big Eye, Monte Carlo).
* Ability to articulate complex data-driven strategies and gain consensus at the executive level.
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications and automation to enhance supply chain/product development.
* Strong commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About this Opportunity:**  
At Regency Centers, our people are our greatest asset, and we believe that our highly skilled and talented team makes us better. We are seeking a full-time Project Manager (Construction) to join our regional office located in Walnut Creek, California. The Project Manager leads construction across an assigned portfolio of existing shopping centers, with a primary focus on tenant improvements, landlord work, redevelopment, space reconfigurations, and property capital improvements. They manage budgets, schedules, consultants, and contractors from scope development and design through permitting, construction, tenant turnover, and closeout. This position works closely with Leasing, Property Management, Tenant Coordination, and Development Accounting to meet lease obligations and operating needs while coordinating work around existing tenants and customers. The Project Manager handles multiple concurrent projects and may support major ground-up developments as assigned.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**  

* Manage construction at existing shopping centers, including landlord work, tenant improvements, white box work, vacant space preparation, space divisions, redevelopment, and facade renovations. Ensure delivery is on time, on budget, and consistent with lease, design, and brand standards.
* Assist with ground up development projects.
* Collaborate with Leasing, Tenant Coordination, Property Management, and Legal to define landlord delivery obligations, evaluate scopes of work, and align lease language and construction exhibits. Coordinate landlord work with tenant delivery requirements.
* Lead budgeting and scheduling for tenant, redevelopment, and property construction projects, including estimates for landlord lease obligations and capital improvements. Monitor and forecast costs, address risks, and track deviations from plan.
* Oversee the preparation and execution of construction contracts and change orders in partnership with Contract Administration. Ensure contractor performance, insurance compliance, and lien waiver documentation.
* Manage existing condition assessments, design, permitting, and utility coordination for tenant work, redevelopment, and property improvements. Evaluate constructability, support entitlement approvals when needed, and plan construction phasing to limit disruption to tenants and customers.
* Manage assigned property capital improvements in coordination with Property Management, including roof replacements, parking lot reconstruction, facade work, HVAC replacements, and major site or building system upgrades.
* Track project milestones, landlord completion dates, and closeout requirements. Maintain project reporting tools and internal dashboards, and provide regular updates to construction leadership, Property Management, Tenant Coordination, and Accounting.

Are You Qualified?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field
* Minimum five (5) years of retail or commercial construction management experience, to include supervisory experience
* Ability to travel regionally & frequently visit all assigned construction sites
* Ability to work varying and flexible hours as needed for tenant delivery, construction in operating shopping centers, and public meetings
* Experience with tenant improvements, redevelopment, and construction in operating shopping centers preferred
* Knowledge of retail construction, tenant improvements, redevelopment, existing building systems, and permitting
* Skilled in reviewing documents for conformity to standards of Regency jurisdictions and/or tenants
* Ability to comprehend architectural and engineering drawings and complex legal documents
* Proficiency with personal computers and MS Office, MS Excel, MS Project, Zoom, & JD Edwards software
* Skilled in analyzing construction costs for landlord lease obligations, tenant improvements, redevelopment, and property capital projects and recommending budgetary adjustments as appropriate
* Regency Centers will not sponsor employment-based immigration petitions or applications for this position, including but not limited to H-1B, TN visa, or permanent residency.

**Personal Traits We Value:**  

* Project management skills (planning, organizing, informing, directing others)
* Decisiveness, problem-solving, time-management, multi-tasking and presentation skills
* Communication skills (interpersonal savvy, customer focus, oral and written communication)
* Trust and integrity
* Negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Ability to work within a team environment

**A Little Bit About Us:**  
We own and operate premier shopping centers in suburban neighborhoods in the top cities and markets across the country. We live by a strong set of values, which have guided us for more than 60 years.
  
  
Our centers thrive with highly productive grocers, restaurants, service providers, and terrific retailers that connect to their communities and customers. We are also active developers of new shopping centers that feature great merchandising, placemaking, and customer engagement as part of our Fresh Look™ program.
  
  
We are a vertically integrated real estate company and a qualified real estate investment trust (REIT) that is self-administered, self-managed, and an S&P 500 Index member. Learn more about us at RegencyCenters.com.
  
  
**Benefits:**  
Our compensation and benefits package is very competitive and includes the following benefits and more. For additional information visit www.regencycenters.com/careers.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  

* 23+ PTO days annually
* 11 paid holidays (in addition to PTO)
* Paid leave programs (parental, compassion, bereavement, jury duty, and military)
* Health Advocacy + Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Financial Security
  

* 401(k) with a generous company match plus corporate profit sharing
* Anniversary stock grant awards
* Health Savings Account

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesProject ManagementID: 28864

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

### **About Roblox Live**

Roblox Live **creates the moments that bring Roblox together**. We turn music, entertainment, culture, and the creativity of our community into new ways to play and connect. From major platform celebrations to live performances and breakout creator moments, we give players something to show up for, experience with friends, and come back to.

We’re a small, fast-moving team with the ambition to **shape the future of live experiences on Roblox**. We bring ideas to life with creators and partners, build the technology that makes them possible, and turn what works into tools that let the creator community take it further.

### **The Role**

We’re looking for a **Senior Program Manager** to turn our slate of live experiences into a coordinated program. You will own the calendar, cross-team dependencies, budget ask, risk register, executive communications, and post-event playbooks. You will help shape new programs early, bringing ideas on formats and audience hooks, then build the plan that takes them through launch and learning.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can turn ambiguity into a plan and lead across teams through trust and judgment. You’ll work closely with creative, content, product, engineering, marketing, safety, and external partners. You’ll align the program around shared goals, partner with the Live Ops Producer on launch readiness and event-day escalations, and give leadership a clear view of progress and decisions.

### **You Will:**

* Turn the programming slate into a forward calendar with clear phases, milestones, decision gates, and owners. Manage dependencies and resource conflicts across events in concept, production, and live operation.
* Help define each program’s audience, goals, and success measures. Bring creative and operational judgment to early concepts, and make practical recommendations on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.
* Build and maintain one shared view of program status. Establish how workstream owners update plans, track commitments, and resolve blockers across internal teams and partners.

* Consolidate staffing, studio, vendor, and production estimates into a program budget request. Partner with Finance and workstream owners to track commitments, spend, and changes against the approved plan.
* Maintain the risk register, including assumptions, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans. Assign owners, surface risks early, and recommend changes that protect the program’s goals and delivery dates.
* Give executives concise updates on outcomes, progress, risks, and decisions needed. Give workstream owners the detail they need to act, with clear commitments and next steps.
* Establish decision owners and escalation paths before launch. Support the Live Ops Producer during live events by resolving cross-team dependencies and coordinating leadership decisions and communications.
* Lead retrospectives and publish post-event readouts with Data Science and functional leads. Track program results, partner contributions, and creative concepts against the goals set before launch.
* Turn lessons and operating runbooks into reusable program playbooks. Track follow-up actions and improve planning, handoffs, and reporting so each event starts with what the team has already learned.

### **You Have**

* 7+ years in program management, production, or live operations, including 3+ years leading live events, recurring content programs, or partner programs.
* A track record of building and running complex programs across creative, technical, and business teams, with multiple initiatives moving at once.
* Experience consolidating budget requests, tracking program financials, and managing risks and dependencies through delivery.
* Strong judgment about scope, priorities, and escalation, with the ability to make progress before every detail is settled.
* Proven ability to lead without formal authority and build lasting trust with internal teams and external partners.
* Clear writing and executive communication, with experience connecting program activity to measurable outcomes.
* Fluency with program management tools such as Jira, Airtable, Asana, or equivalents, and the ability to build practical tracking and reporting systems.
* Experience in gaming, creator platforms, entertainment, live events, or esports (preferred).
* Experience building a program or operating model from scratch that other teams adopted (preferred).
* Familiarity with Roblox and its player and creator communities (preferred).
* Experience evaluating partner programs or creative concepts through shared goals and scorecards (preferred).

**About Gap**
-------------

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand – our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

**About the role**
------------------

The Project Manager, New Capabilities will play a key role in developing and implementing strategic initiatives that enhance the customer journey or improve our store operating model to drive incremental sales and profitable growth. This role will collaborate, influence, and strategize with cross-functional business partners to design business solutions, and support implementation of major projects from planning through field execution. **What you'll do**

jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Immersion & Testing
jobs.description:
Meta is building the future of human connection through technology. Our family of apps and services connects billions of people worldwide, empowering them to share what matters most and bringing people closer together. Central to our mission is ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality and user satisfaction.The Product Immersion & Testing Team within Business Product Marketing (BPM) is seeking a Program Manager who is passionate about customer insights, testing, launching, and scaling Meta's newest business and marketing solutions. We accelerate business growth and product development by integrating the voice of the customer into our product marketing flywheel, leveraging insights to drive impactful strategies and outcomes.As an ideal candidate, you have experience navigating ambiguity, defining project scope independently, and aligning stakeholders around a clear plan of action. You have a proven track record of managing complex projects, collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, and leveraging customer insights and data analysis to inform decisions. You have deep experience with Meta's business tools (e.g., Ads Manager), marketing, and measurement, and you have experience distilling complex ideas into actionable insights.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Product Immersion & Testing Responsibilities:**

* Lead Product Immersion & Testing Initiatives: Manage, monitor, and recruit for product tests (alpha, beta, GA) and immersions, driving delivery of multiple projects as the main point of contact for Product, Sales, and Data Science
* Planning and Strategy: Define goals, identify clients, coordinate logistics, and compile key information into briefs for immersion and testing projects
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work extensively with Product Managers, Product Marketing, Data Science, Engineering, and User Research to scope immersion and test design/requirements, manage logistics, and surface insights to influence for product and business outcomes (product changes, roadmap impact)
* Communication: Effectively communicate relevant insights and findings to cross-functional teams, influencing roadmap prioritization and developing solutions to fix problems at scale
* Process Improvement: Inform, influence, and execute new processes based on analysis and impact metrics to improve efficiency and quality of support
* Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and problem-solve issues (bugs, feature requests, product confusions) during testing and immersions, utilizing escalation paths and updating stakeholders
* Travel: Support in-market experiences, with up to 20% travel (including international)

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree in a relevant field (e.g., Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field)
* 4+ years' experience in program/project management, customer service, marketing, user/UX research, operations, or product testing
* 4+ years' experience managing, tracking, and measuring digital marketing campaigns
* Experience initiating and driving projects to completion with minimal guidance
* Experience building relationships with cross-functional teams, delivering impact through communication and influence
* Experience implementing processes/programs to improve product or team performance
* Confidence working independently and leading cross-functional teams
* Understanding of product development, market research, and testing principles
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
* Experience with internal project management tools and escalation paths

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Comfortable dealing with high-pressure, fast-moving, and ambiguous problems
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with Ads Manager and/or other Meta ad platform interfaces
* Experience working with a broad range of customers or user segments
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with A/B testing
* Experience contributing at both strategic and operational levels

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world.
