jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Prelim is growing 2-3x annually and our platform powers account opening and onboarding for banks across the country. Our team is at a turning point: the informal systems that got us here won't scale with where we're headed next.

Today, the work of coordinating across teams, tracking delivery, and keeping the company’s operational rhythm falls on the founder — who is also our head of product — and on the leads themselves. That’s not sustainable and we know it.

As our first Business Operations hire, you’ll build the operational infrastructure Prelim runs on. There’s no playbook and no predecessor. You’ll decide what to systematize first, build processes that scale, and manage our two technical account managers.

**What You'll Own**

* **The company operating system.** You'll build and run the lightweight systems that give leadership a weekly view of who's working on what, team load, and delivery risk across product and implementations. When a new bank comes in, you're the person who looks at current allocation, identifies who has capacity, and presents staffing options — not the founder doing it from memory in a Slack DM. You surface stalled projects, overloaded teams, and unanswered customer concerns before they become emergencies.
* **Our technical account management team.** Our two TAMs report to you. You'll hold regular 1:1s, track goals, provide feedback, and develop them. You own their workload and development; the founders retain executive ownership of bank relationships and account strategy.
* **Staffing and project coordination.** When projects need to be reassigned, when someone goes out of office, when a customer issue needs routing to the right lead, you make sure the handoff happens and nothing gets dropped. You maintain the map of who covers what. And when an implementation goes sideways, the lead who owns it runs the recovery. Your job is making sure every client concern has an owner, a plan, and a next check-in date, and that nothing quietly goes dark. If a project stalls or has no owner, you flag it before the client does.
* **Operational rhythm.** Lead syncs have agendas. Cycle kickoffs happen on a schedule. Commitments from meetings get tracked and followed up on. You own the cadence that keeps the company running smoothly.
* **Vendor and logistics management.** You’ll collaborate with People Operations on software contracts, offsites, and team meetups.

**What You** ***Won't*** **Own**

You won't recover client projects yourself — our leads own recovery on their accounts; you own making sure recovery is happening. You won't own client strategy or the executive relationship with our banks — account health, expansion, and voice-of-customer stay with the founder. You're not making product decisions — the founder and product leads own the roadmap, though what you see in the operating data should shape it. And beyond our two TAMs, you're not a people manager — team leads manage their own reports.

**What We're Looking For**

* **4-6 years spanning delivery leadership and business operations**, including a leadership role at a B2B software company or a smaller group in a larger tech company.
* **You've personally done the work at least once.** You've run complex enterprise implementations or owned technical accounts yourself, recently enough that your teams will trust your judgment in an client-facing communications.
* **You're a strong writer and communicator.** The operational documentation, staffing plans, and status rhythms don't exist yet; you'll create them, and they'll only work if they're clear and concise.
* **You're relentlessly organized without being bureaucratic.** You add just enough structure that things don't fall through cracks, and you know the difference between useful process and process for its own sake.
* **You're direct and unintimidated.** You'll tell a lead their team is overloaded, and you'll tell the founder he committed to something we don't have capacity for.

**Nice to Have, Not Required**

* Experience in fintech or selling into banks
* Familiarity with tools like Linear, Notion, Pylon, Mixpanel
* Experience supporting a technical team (engineering, design, implementations)

**What You Won't Find in This Role**

A mature org to administer. You'll work directly with the founder daily, interim structures, and make the org-design decisions a founder has been making from memory. The decisions you make will directly determine the reach and scope of our mission.

**How You'll Know It's Working**

A month in, the founder stops being the person asking "who's covering this." Three months in, there's a weekly load-and-risk snapshot leadership relies on, and every implementation has a clear owner and status. Six months in, a new bank's staffing conversation takes fifteen minutes, client concerns have an owner who isn't the founder.

**About Prelim**

Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation.

We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company retreats. This role would also attend periodic team meetups in NYC and SF.

Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

Compensation Range: $240K - $260K

jobs.title: Project Manager - Business Transformation
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Kiona Technologies specializes in delivering comprehensive business intelligence, analytics, and decision support services. With a focus on foresight and innovative technology, we empower organizations to anticipate challenges and seize opportunities through advanced predictive intelligence systems.

**Overview**

Kiona is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead complex business transformation initiatives. In this role, you will drive cross-functional projects that enable operational improvement, organizational change, and measurable business value.

Successful candidates bring structure to ambiguity, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and create accountability across diverse stakeholder groups. You know how to leverage subject matter expertise, navigate competing priorities, and keep teams focused on delivering results without assuming ownership of business or technical decisions.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead projects from intake through delivery and closure, maintaining accountability for scope, schedule, budget, risks, and dependencies.
* Develop and maintain project plans, RAID logs, financial forecasts, and executive-ready status reporting.
* Identify delivery risks early and drive mitigation activities before commitments are impacted.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and escalation paths.
* Facilitate resolution of competing priorities, cross-functional dependencies, and delivery obstacles.
* Coordinate stakeholders, vendors, and subject matter experts to ensure commitments are met.
* Maintain alignment between business objectives, delivery commitments, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with business leaders and change management resources to support adoption and operational readiness.
* Communicate project health, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations with transparency and confidence.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stakeholders trust your reporting because it is accurate, transparent, and actionable.
* Risks, dependencies, and issues are addressed proactively rather than reactively.
* Ambiguity surrounding ownership, decisions, and commitments is resolved quickly.
* You bring solutions and recommendations, not just problems.
* Business and technical leaders retain decision ownership while you drive execution.
* Projects are delivered against agreed commitments and business outcomes are realized.
* Teams seek to work with you again because of your leadership, organization, and accountability.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
* Experience leading business transformation, process improvement, organizational change, or enterprise initiatives.
* Demonstrated ownership of project scope, schedule, budget, risks, and delivery outcomes.
* Proven ability to perform effectively in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and evolving requirements.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Program Manager – Energy Efficiency & Consolidation
jobs.description:
**About the client**  
Our client is a global leader in sustainable telecom network solutions, operating in the UK, Ireland, the USA and across Europe, Australia, South Africa and Brazil. They help extend the life of telecom networks through multi-vendor parts sourcing, responsible decommissioning and network engineering, with a strong focus on the circular economy and reducing environmental impact.

**Why this role matters**  
As a key member of the Infrastructure Program team, you'll lead delivery of a large-scale infrastructure efficiency, consolidation and decommissioning program across a complex telecommunications estate.

You'll coordinate infrastructure consolidation, energy-efficiency initiatives, DC power optimization, cooling efficiency, network shutdown and site exits. Your job is to bring multiple technical and operational workstreams together to deliver measurable energy, cost and infrastructure reductions with minimal operational disruption.

You'll be the central program owner, working across Infrastructure, Network Operations, Energy Efficiency, Engineering, Real Estate, Field Operations and external suppliers.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of the infrastructure efficiency, consolidation and decommissioning program
* Build and maintain the integrated program roadmap, milestones, dependencies and delivery plans
* Coordinate infrastructure, network, energy, HVAC/cooling, property and field-service workstreams
* Develop and manage site consolidation, infrastructure removal and site-exit plans
* Coordinate DC power and rectifier optimization, replacement, retrofit and consolidation
* Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure power consumption and cooling overhead
* Coordinate network shutdown, migration and legacy equipment decommissioning
* Establish a single, validated site and asset baseline for planning and benefits measurement
* Manage program RAID, governance, budgets, forecasts and supplier performance
* Coordinate internal engineering teams, field resources, OEMs and third-party partners
* Track and report measurable benefits, including energy, infrastructure and operating cost reductions
* Provide clear reporting to senior stakeholders on progress, risks, finances and benefits
* Support business cases for infrastructure replacement, retrofit, reuse and recovery
* Maintain operational controls when working on live telecommunications infrastructure

**What we're looking for**

* Proven experience as a Program Manager or Senior Program Manager delivering complex infrastructure programs
* Background in telecommunications, data centers, critical infrastructure or similar environments
* Experience with large-scale consolidation, decommissioning, transformation or site-exit programs
* Strong understanding of DC power infrastructure and telecom rectifier environments
* Understanding of energy efficiency, power consumption and cooling optimization
* Experience coordinating multi-site field delivery and decommissioning
* Strong program governance, RAID, financial and benefits-management skills
* Strong analytical skills, including asset and site-level data
* Excellent communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders
* Strong commercial and supplier-management experience
* Good understanding of operational risk in live infrastructure environments

**Nice to have**

* Telecom DC power platforms such as Galaxy, Millennium, 596, Lorain, OmniOn/ABB and Vertiv
* HVAC and cooling in telecom or critical environments (EC fans, VFDs, airflow management, setpoint optimization)
* Legacy technology decommissioning, including TDM, voice and DACS
* Asset, inventory and site-management systems
* Energy and facilities data, including PUE and energy-consumption measurement
* Field-service, asset recovery and infrastructure logistics

**Contract details**

* W2 contract
* Remote, US-based, with occasional travel to sites as required
* Must be authorized to work in the US

Pay: From $80.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* How many years have you worked as a Program Manager on infrastructure programs?
* Have you delivered telecom, data center or critical infrastructure decommissioning or consolidation programs? Briefly describe the largest.
* Give an example of a high-pressure situation you managed at a senior level?

Work Location: Remote

HP5 Consulting is seeking an experienced Lead Health Economist / Project Manager to support a healthcare accessibility study for the Indian Health Service. The selected individual will evaluate healthcare costs, service availability, and referral networks to develop recommendations that improve access and guide investment decisions.

Responsibilities

* Develop healthcare economic models, comparative cost analyses, and budget impact assessments.
* Analyze healthcare utilization, spending, referral, claims, and encounter data.
* Evaluate direct-care expansion versus Purchased/Referred Care.
* Perform break-even modeling, sensitivity analyses, and prioritization within available budgets.

* Consider patient travel burden, continuity of care, cultural context, equity, and implementation feasibility.
* Prepare reports, decision-support workbooks, reproducible code, technical documentation, and leadership presentations.

* At least five years of relevant experience in health economics, healthcare cost analysis, budget impact analysis, cost-effectiveness or cost-consequence analysis, or related decision modeling.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing health system data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Proficiency in R, Stata, SAS, Python, or a comparable analytical tool.
* Expert Excel skills or equivalent experience developing transparent decision-support workbooks.
* Strong technical writing, presentation, project coordination, and communication skills.

Preferred Experience

* Rural healthcare access.
* Tribal health systems or federal health programs.
* Purchased/Referred Care or comparable referral systems.

Work Arrangement

This position is remote. Candidates must be available for scheduled meetings and coordination Monday–Friday during core government business hours of 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. Eastern. Occasional approved travel may be required for credentialing, onboarding, or site visits.

**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Director, Professional Services  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $100,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Core Implementation Manager (Core IM) is the sole owner of a portfolio of roughly 40+ First Due Core implementations, typically multi-module engagements. These standard and moderately complex projects carry real configuration complexity and frequently include CAD integration and historical data migration, requiring disciplined project management, strong customer command, and the ability to direct several internal specialists toward a single go-live date.

The Core IM owns the customer relationship and every project in the portfolio from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, and is accountable for planned duration, scope, risk, customer communication, and time to value. This is a fully autonomous role: you are self-directed on all delivery decisions inside the signed SOW and involve leadership only on commercial and relationship exceptions. Core delivery runs on a paired model: the Implementation Manager owns the project, the assigned Implementation Consultant owns module configuration and functional product depth, and Technical Services owns integration and data migration execution.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own a full portfolio of roughly 40+ concurrent Core implementations from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, consistently holding planned duration below team goal.
* Keep Rocketlane, the system of record, current always (plans, timelines, milestones, task status, owners, and dates) so any colleague can open a project and know exactly where it stands. Complete documentation and exit gates on time, not retroactively.
* Lead customer kickoffs with command: set clear expectations, correct unrealistic assumptions in the room, and close with an agreed action list, owners, and dates. Adapt the agenda to each agency’s politics and readiness based on Discovery.
* Run a progress cadence of at least bi-weekly check-ins on new acquisition projects and monthly on upsells, using each one to find and remove the real blocker rather than read status.
* Tailor each plan to the agency’s operational reality, including shift patterns, governance and approval cycles, budget calendars, and go-live blackout windows. Own multi-module sequencing, phasing, and dependency decisions across the platform.
* Direct and sequence the work of Implementation Consultants, Technical Services, Integrations, Support, and Product without direct authority, securing commitment on dates. Module configuration is owned by the assigned Implementation Consultant.
* Proactively surface product gaps, process gaps, communication silos, and methodology friction to leadership with supporting specifics and a proposed fix, and help own internal improvement efforts.

### **Qualifications:**

* This is a remote role, but the person hired must live in the US.
* 5+ years of experience managing customer-facing SaaS implementations (or 3+ years plus a master’s degree), including a portfolio of multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, including how fire, EMS, or law enforcement agencies operate and how decisions are made inside them.
* Demonstrated ownership of project plans, timelines, risk management, escalation recovery, and scope discipline, including change orders, on projects with multiple internal contributors.
* Proven ability to drive delivery outcomes through matrixed contributors without direct reporting authority.
* Working data literacy: comfortable reading record counts, spotting bad mappings, and assessing integration and migration risk.
* Experience with implementation project management tooling.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise, actionable follow-ups, status reporting an executive stakeholder can act on, and delivering bad news early with a recommended path.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working to billable utilization targets in a professional services organization.
* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management credential.
* Experience with fire, EMS, or law enforcement records management, CAD systems, or emergency services software.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce.
* Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment with evolving methodology and tooling.

**For US-based Roles**  
All applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer in the United States. Locality Media LLC is unable to sponsor or transition sponsorship ownership of employment visas at this time. Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the US, Locality Media participates in E-Verify.  
  
**Physical Demands and Work Environment**  
This role is fully remote with minimal travel expectations at this time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified employees and applicants to perform the essential functions as outlined above. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please reach out to people@firstdue.com.  
  
**Working at First Due**  
First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. Visit www.firstdue.c

jobs.description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks.With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.

The Strategic Initiatives Program Manager is a strategic leader responsible for driving high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that enable Revenue Operations and Go-to-Market (GTM) success. This role partners closely with executive leadership to translate business strategy into executable programs, ensuring alignment, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.

This individual combines exceptional program management rigor with strong business fluency, change leadership, and the ability to leverage AI-driven tools and data insights to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

#LI-Remote

What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

* Lead strategic, multi-workstream programs that advance Revenue Operations and GTM priorities from concept through delivery, encompassing strategic sales acceleration motions (e.g., cross-sell, installed-base expansion) and core revenue tooling and quoting system transformations (e.g., CPQ, commercial platforms)
* Partner with executive leaders (including CSO, CFO, and VP-level stakeholders) to define program objectives, align priorities, and ensure strategic initiatives deliver measurable business value.
* Develop and manage comprehensive program plans across multiple concurrent workstreams, including timelines, milestones, dependencies, resource allocation, risk registers, and success metrics.

* Proactively identify program risks, dependencies, and roadblocks, developing mitigation strategies that keep initiatives on track (e.g., UAT sequencing, logic constraints, reporting gaps).

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence across cross-functional teams, including vendors, and internal business stakeholders

What You'll Need to be Successful:

* 8+ years of experience leading complex program management, strategy and operations, or business transformation initiatives within a Go-to-Market or Revenue Operations organization.
* 4+ years of experience leading organizational change management or enterprise transformation programs across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Technology workstreams.
* Proven track record successfully managing concurrent, high-stakes programs involving cross-functional dependencies and executive sponsorship—such as sales expansion/cross-sell motions, commercial engine optimizations, or revenue platform/quoting system implementations (e.g., CPQ, commercial operations tooling).

* Strong strategic thinking, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance tactical execution and long-term planning across competing priorities.

Avalara is an AI-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

  
What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

jobs.title: Junior Project Coordinator Internship (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About Scale**
---------------

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-driven **Junior Project Coordinator** to keep our creative and development teams moving. You'll own weekly sprint planning for our Design team, keep tickets moving by following up with stakeholders, and keep our project management workspace in Wrike accurate and up to date.

This is a great entry-level opportunity for someone looking to grow in project coordination. You'll work closely with designers, developers, and project managers, gaining hands-on experience with sprint planning and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

This is a fully remote, part-time, standalone role at 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Pacific. You'll report to Krystal Perez, Project Manager, and support our Design and Software Development teams as well as our Project Managers. Within your first 60 days, you'll run the weekly sprint review independently and manage stakeholder follow-ups with minimal oversight.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Design Sprint Planning & Prioritization (Core Focus)**

* Build and prioritize the Design team's weekly sprint using established guidelines.
* Check in with each designer at the end of every week to confirm what's complete, what's carrying over, and why.
* Lead a weekly call with brand project managers to review sprint priorities and discuss tickets planned for upcoming sprints.

### **Stakeholder Follow-Up & Blocker Management**

* Follow up with ticket stakeholders when work is blocked by slow reviews, open questions, or missing information.
* Schedule touch-base calls at the start of a sprint for design tickets that need more detailed alignment beyond the brief.
* Escalate to your manager when a mission-critical item is still at risk, or when a ticket has had no movement for 3 to 4 days.
* Provide the same follow-up and escalation support for Software Development tickets.

### **Daily Ticket Assignment**

* Assign daily quick-turn tickets to the two designated designers, following a documented SOP.
* Confirm each ticket has the details a designer needs before it's assigned.

### **Project Manager Support**

* Help project managers build out new key projects in Wrike, including tasks, timelines, assignees, and fields.

### **Wrike Maintenance & Data Quality**

* Keep Wrike accurate and organized by updating statuses, cleaning up stale or duplicate items, and filling in missing fields.
* Help build out the Wrike onboarding space currently in development, including organizing resources and how-to content.
* Review new requests for missing information and send them back to requesters before they reach the team.

### **Reporting & Data Cleanup**

* Clean up monthly ticket data used for team productivity and workload reporting, and follow up with stakeholders on any missing information.
* Spot-check dashboards and automated status updates to confirm they're pulling correctly.
* Draft routine internal updates, reminders, and announcements for review.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Follow-Through:** Tracks open items to resolution and follows up independently.
* **Proactive Communication:** Seeks clarification at the start of a task and flags blockers or deadline risks as soon as they arise.
* **Responsiveness:** Replies promptly to Slack messages and Wrike comments during working hours.
* **Accuracy:** Keeps due dates, assignees, statuses, and ticket details correct and current.
* **Professional Communication:** Writes clear, polished, and concise messages to stakeholders at all levels.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* A bachelor's degree with at least one administrative, coordination, or project support internship, or 1 to 2 years of administrative experience.
* Hands-on experience with a project management tool such as Wrike, Asana, Monday.com, Jira, ClickUp, or Trello.
* Polished, professional written communication, especially in Slack and project management tools.
* A proven habit of following up independently and meeting deadlines.
* Comfort asking questions and raising blockers early.
* Availability to work 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Pacific, Monday to Friday.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Wrike specifically.
* Experience supporting creative, design, marketing, or software development teams.
* Familiarity with agile or sprint-based workflows.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, and basic spreadsheet work like sorting, filtering, and cleaning data.

**What We Offer**

* Salary: $25 per hour
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Fully remote, full-time position
* Monthly work-from-home stipend
* Generous paid time off program
* Discounted products
* An amazing team to work alongside

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Title:** ***Service Project Coordinator***

**Working Pattern:** ***Full Time***

**Working location:** ***Lockport, Louisiana***

*Relocation assistance is not available for this position.*

  

**Why Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

  

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.

  

You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is **Infinite Potential** . And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.

  

**Position Summary**

*The Service Project Coordinator supports the execution of large-engine service projects by coordinating warranty activities, financial reporting, project administration, invoicing, and government contract requirements. This role serves as a key partner to Service Managers, Finance, and operational teams to ensure projects are executed efficiently, customer commitments are fulfilled, and financial performance is accurately tracked. Through strong coordination and operational oversight, the position contributes directly to service excellence and business performance across the Large Engine Services organization. The individual in this role will be required to be onsite on a hybrid basis at the customer location in Lockport, Louisiana to focus on assisting technicians, reporting, and monitoring job progression on the customer site.*

  

**What you will be doing**

* *Coordinate the administrative and financial execution of large-engine service projects, including labor tracking, invoicing, quotations, purchase requests, parts management, tooling records, and project documentation.*

* *Manage warranty and work-in-progress activities by tracking claims, supporting failure analysis processes, monitoring open items, and partnering with internal stakeholders to drive timely resolution.*

* *Analyze project financial data, revenue projections, and controlling reports, providing visibility and support for operational decision-making and project performance improvements.*

* *Support government contracts and customer projects by coordinating documentation, invoice submissions, records management, and compliance with applicable customer and contractual requirements.*

* *Partner with Service Managers, Engineering, Finance, and global stakeholders to coordinate corrective actions, improve service execution processes, and support successful project delivery.*

* *Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% of the time to customer sites located around the globe and US Coast Guard Bases. This position will be located in Lockport, Louisiana when travel is not required.*

  

**Basic Requirements:**

* *Associate's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field and at least 3 years of experience in service project coordination, project administration, customer support, warranty administration, or a related field; OR*

* *Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field and at least 1 year of experience in service project coordination, project administration, customer support, warranty administration, or a related field; OR*

* *Master's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field; OR*

* *JD/PhD in Business, Engineering Technology; OR*

* *At least 5 years of relevant experience in service project coordination, project administration, customer support, warranty administration in lieu of a degree.*

* *In order to be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent. Resident Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

  

**Preferred Requirements:**

* *Demonstrated experience supporting service projects involving internal combustion engines, marine equipment, power generation systems, or heavy industrial equipment.*

* *Working knowledge of warranty administration, government contracts, work-in-progress management, project financial reporting, and service operations.*

* *Experience utilizing SAP and related business systems, including MS5, PAS, C4S, PS3, or similar ERP, service, and project-management platforms.*

* *Strong analytical, organizational, and stakeholder-management capabilities, with experience coordinating complex projects involving multiple internal teams, suppliers, customers, or subcontractors.*

  

**Mental & Physical Requirements:**

* *Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.*

* Ability to work at heights, climb ladders, and enter confined spaces as required by field service tasks.

* *Ability to sit, stand, bend, stoop, walk, lift, and use a keyboard or mouse as required to perform the position.*

* *Ability to work time in marine shipyards and vessel engine rooms in an office environment.*

* *Ability to work near moving mechanical equipment and in environments that may include elevated noise, fumes, dust, water, odors, gases, heat, cold, and humidity.*

* *Ability to work a non-traditional schedule and extended hours while performing field-service assignments.*

  

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand ***mtu*** . Through digitalisation and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for Project Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Connected Care (OCC) as it refreshes and expands telehealth equipment at VA medical centers, clinics, and other sites across the country. This position will be fully remote.

Responsibilities:

We're looking for a Project Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Connected Care (OCC) as it refreshes and expands telehealth equipment at VA medical centers, clinics, and other sites across the country. You'll be the day-to-day link between OCC, VISN Telehealth Program Managers, and field staff, keeping equipment requests, delivery schedules, and site communications on track.

This is a good fit for someone early in their PM career who already knows how the VA works and wants to grow into larger program responsibilities.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Coordinate telehealth equipment requests with VA sites and VISNs for technology refresh, expansion and provider iPad ordering orders
* Communicate delivery schedules to sites, track progress, and follow up to validate and finalize open orders
* Answer field questions on installation, ordering, deployment, decommissioning, and 1:1 replacement of end-of-life equipment
* Support recurring VISN Lead, FTC, and TCT calls, plus ad hoc Telehealth Technology office hours, and send out action items within two business days of each meeting
* Build and present slide decks regularly
* Handle incoming questions from field staff by phone, email, and Teams (order status, serial numbers, turn-ins, help desk tickets, vendor site visits)
* Support the OCC loaned mobile device program, including a master tracking log, order and shipment tracking, and check that site requests meet OCC guidelines and order limits
* Communicate equipment recalls to the field
* Maintain the Telehealth Technology Repository Sites: post deadlines, FAQs, and reference docs, build checklists and trackers, and archive outdated material
* Quality check data submitted by sites and follow up on gaps
* Produce the Monthly Synchronous/Asynchronous Equipment Delivery Tracking Status Report and contribute to program dashboards

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree with 2-5 years of work experience (or commensurate experience in lieu of a degree)
* 1 to 3 years of project coordination or project management experience
* Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting to groups
* Comfortable juggling many sites and deadlines at once
* Working knowledge of Microsoft SharePoint, Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting to groups

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience working at or supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs
* Experience working with the VA
* Experience managing technology acquisition and reporting
* Telehealth or connected care experience, especially with VA Video Connect or OCC programs
* Familiarity with VISN structure and field roles such as FTCs and TCTs
* Experience with PowerBI, ServiceNow, or Maximo
* Equipment deployment, logistics, or asset tracking background

**Clearance Required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.

  
Posted Salary Range: USD $90,000.00 - USD $100,000.00 /Yr.

* Resolve cross-team blockers and escalate risks to leadership as needed

* Experience with native mobile (iOS and Android) and web product delivery
* Background working with patient-generated health data (PGHD) or clinical data sources

* Experience with backlog tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence—bringing a broad perspective to problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to team-level goals for cross-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment and the ability to work across a range of variable, often ambiguous risk factors.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering programs for a loosely defined area of work, aligning solutions across teams, and advising cross-functional partners as a subject-matter expert on complex matters in your area.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging.
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high-pressure, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills to improve processes or resolve complex issues
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience in managing cross-functional projects and teams
* Experience in leveraging AI and data-driven insights to continuously improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of a process
* Experience with product development lifecycles and complex systems

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking a Clinical Care Coordinator to support patients, families, and care teams through organized, compassionate, and timely coordination of care. This is a fully remote position open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate will help patients navigate appointments, referrals, follow-up care, and communication across providers while maintaining accurate documentation and protecting patient privacy.

This role is well suited for a clinically trained professional who is comfortable working independently, communicating through phone and digital platforms, and balancing multiple patient needs in a fast-moving healthcare environment. Part-time and full-time schedules are available.

Key responsibilities

* Coordinate patient care activities, referrals, appointments, follow-up services, and transitions between care settings.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for patients, caregivers, providers, and internal care teams.
* Conduct outreach to patients to confirm needs, review care plans, identify barriers, and support completion of next steps.
* Review clinical and administrative information to help identify gaps in care, missed follow-ups, or escalating needs.
* Document outreach, care coordination activities, referrals, and outcomes accurately in the EHR or care-management platform.
* Collaborate with physicians, nurses, case managers, social workers, and other members of the care team.
* Support patient education and reinforce care instructions within the scope of training, licensure, and established protocols.
* Escalate urgent, high-risk, or clinically significant concerns to the appropriate licensed clinician or supervisor.
* Track open items and follow through until the appropriate resolution, handoff, or patient connection is completed.
* Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA, organizational policies, and applicable federal and state requirements.
* Participate in virtual team meetings, quality-improvement activities, and process updates as needed.

Required qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in clinical care coordination, case management, nursing, patient navigation, utilization management, or a closely related healthcare role.
* RN or comparable healthcare education and experience.
* For roles involving nursing practice, an active, unrestricted RN license in the applicable state(s) is required. Candidates must be able to meet any state-specific licensure requirements associated with their assigned work.
* Experience working with an EHR/EMR, care-management platform, patient portal, or similar healthcare technology.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and empathetically.
* Excellent organization, prioritization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently from a home office while remaining responsive and collaborative with a remote team.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and the importance of maintaining confidential patient information.
* Reliable internet connection, private workspace, and ability to use a computer, headset, video-conferencing tools, and common productivity software.

Preferred qualifications

* BSN, MSN, or graduate degree in nursing, social work, public health, healthcare administration, or related field.
* Certifications such as CCM, ACM, CPHQ, or other relevant care management or quality credentials.
* Experience with chronic-care management, behavioral health, transitional care, population health, or value-based care.
* RN, LPN/LVN, or experienced Certified/Registered Medical Assistant, Clinical Care Coordinator – Medicare Care Management (APCM/CCM) - Examples may include an ADN or BSN with an active RN license, or a related degree/credential such as social work, public health, health administration, or allied health with substantial care-coordination experience.
* Experience supporting patients across multiple providers, payers, or healthcare settings.
* Bilingual or multilingual communication skills relevant to the patient population.

Success in this role looks like

* Patients understand their next steps and receive timely follow-ups.
* Referrals, appointments, and care transitions are tracked through completion.
* Documentation is accurate, complete, and entered promptly.
* Care-team members receive clear updates and escalations when needed.
* The coordinator consistently demonstrates empathy, sound judgment, and dependable follow-through.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**OUR MISSION**

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person’s cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help care teams focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you’re inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what’s possible, we’d love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

* You will keep track of team members’ training modules completion, progress, and understanding by listening to interactions with members and assessing them against our quality standards.

jobs.description:
**What we are looking for:**

  

**Important:** For this role we are only considering US-based candidates who are able & willing to work from Wednesday to Sunday every week.

  

We are seeking a highly motivated Test Manager to lead Quality Assurance for a AAA game development team. You will lead embedded testing teams, and partner with cross-functional leadership to balance quality, schedule, and risk in a complex development environment.

  

**What we will do together:**

  

QA Strategy & Leadership

* Define global QA strategy, test objectives, quality gates, and risk-based testing methodologies for major project milestones.
* Integrate QA into early development planning to ensure quality is a core part of the feature lifecycle rather than just final validation.

  

People Management

* Mentor and develop a high-performing team of QA Leads and testers, fostering a culture of ownership and collaboration.
* Manage both internal and external QA resources effectively to meet project demands.

  

Test Planning & Execution

* Oversee comprehensive test execution across functional, gameplay, performance, stability, multiplayer, and platform certification areas.
* Monitor defect trends and quality risks, ensuring critical issues are prioritized and driven to resolution.

  

Defect & Risk Management

* Analyze defect data to identify systemic quality issues and drive root-cause analysis and preventative initiatives.
* Communicate emerging quality risks and technical assessments clearly to Production and project leadership.

  

Milestone & Release Management

* Establish QA schedules and deliverables for major milestones, providing objective assessments of build stability and release readiness.
* Coordinate final regression and stabilization efforts during high-pressure release periods.

  

Platform Certification

* Lead preparation for first-party certification, coordinating test plans and tracking submission risks to ensure successful launches.

  

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Advocate for quality as the senior QA representative within project leadership, balancing technical standards with production constraints.
* Build strong partnerships across disciplines to establish a shared responsibility for quality across the entire development team.

  

External & Co-Development QA

* Manage external vendors and co-development QA teams, defining expectations and reporting standards to ensure seamless integration with internal strategy.

  

QA Tools, Metrics & Process Improvement

* Implement data-driven reporting and dashboards to track build health, test coverage, and milestone progress.
* Continuously improve QA efficiency through automation, tooling, and process retrospectives.

  

**What you will bring:**

* 7+ years in software QA with 3+ years managing teams in game development.
* Proven track record of shipping at least one major AAA title across the full development lifecycle.
* Expertise in developing test strategies, risk-based testing, and Agile methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership.

  

Nice to have

Escape Velocity is a team of passionate, talented developers working at a studio that offers excellent benefits, on what we believe is a once-in-a-career project with a committed publisher. We're dedicated to building a culture of play, which not only makes us better game makers, but also strengthens the bonds between us all. We believe in constant improvement across all areas – from the game itself to our production design – and are constantly re-evaluating how we spend our time to ensure that we're not wasting yours and we're all always working on the most important things.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as an RCM Account Manager. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing client accounts, ensuring accurate and timely billing, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining strong client relationships. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in healthcare billing procedures, exceptional organizational skills, and a dedication to providing exceptional customer service.

### **About Heno INC**

HENO was founded by Jeff Hohman, a software engineer, and Katie Hohman, a physical therapist since 2006 and owner of three private practice clinics in Central Florida. When they opened their first clinic, the husband-and-wife team relied on four to five different software systems to manage their practice. This approach quickly proved inefficient and disorganized.

“For the first six months [using multiple platforms], we had no idea whether we were making or losing money,” Katie explained.

As their operations expanded to additional clinics, managing multiple systems became increasingly challenging. Determined to find a better solution, Jeff and Katie set out to develop a software that would simplify practice management and eliminate the chaos of using fragmented tools.

Drawing on Jeff's expertise in software engineering and Katie's hands-on experience managing clinics, they created HENO — the only EMR built by a physical therapist and private practice owner. This all-in-one platform is designed to save time, reduce costs, and streamline operations. By offering HENO to physical therapy practices everywhere, the Hohmans aim to empower clinicians to focus less on administrative tasks and more on what truly matters — the patient.

### **Description**

**Now Hiring: Medical Billing Account Manager**

**Join a fast-growing health tech company revolutionizing Physical Therapy billing!**

**Are you:**

* Enthusiastic and solution-oriented?
* A master of Physical Therapy Medical Billing?
* Seeking a role with real growth potential?
* Ready to prove your leadership and expertise?
* Ambitious and motivated to take your career to the next level?

If so, HENO may be the perfect fit for you.

**Who is HENO?**

**HENO is a rapidly expanding EMR and billing software platform serving Physical Therapy clinics nationwide. With our client base growing quickly and revenue doubling year-over-year, we’re seeking a talented and driven** **Medical Billing Account Manager** **to help elevate our client service experience and support continued growth.**

**Role Overview:**

**As a Medical Billing Account Manager, you’ll be a critical leader in our billing service division. You will oversee billing team operations, ensure quality and timeliness of service, and act as the main liaison between HENO and our valued PT clinic clients.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Monitor PT clinic billing accounts daily to identify and resolve incomplete or incorrect work.
* Coordinate with onboarding to ensure seamless setup for new clients—ensuring no disruption to their cash flow.
* Maintain consistent communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and resolve issues promptly.
* Supervise daily tasks including claims processing, rejection and denial resolution, payment posting, and patient statement delivery.
* Perform quality checks on billing team outputs and ensure all errors are corrected.
* Develop internal SOPs, guides, and checklists to streamline services.
* Train the billing team on best practices for client communication.
* Analyze reports to identify trends, inefficiencies, or potential problems.
* Provide feedback and feature suggestions to management and the product development team.

**What You Bring:**

  

* 3–5 years’ experience in Physical Therapy Medical Billing.
* 3–5 years’ experience working in a billing service environment.
* Proven experience communicating directly with medical clinic clients.
* Strong skills in managing rejections, denials, and overdue claims.
* Experience acting as a liaison between internal billing staff and clients.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) preferred, but not required.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.

**Why Work With Us?**

**At HENO, we’re committed to creating a culture of excellence, innovation, and growth. You’ll join a team that values transparency, client success, and internal development. If you're ready to take ownership of your work and grow into a leadership role, we want to meet you!**

$19 - $21 per hour

* Experience with Snowflake, relational databases, and reporting tools such as Power BI
* Proven ability to turn messy operational data into reliable, decision-ready insights
* Track record presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders and/or clients
* Strong attention to detail, independent judgment, and ability to manage multiple priorities

**Purpose**

As an **Account Manager – New Jersey**, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding BVI’s presence across the assigned territory. You will develop and maintain strong relationships with ophthalmic surgeons, clinical teams, and healthcare organizations while identifying opportunities to introduce and expand BVI’s portfolio. The role combines strategic territory management, consultative selling, clinical product support, and new business development across hospitals, ASCs, and private practice settings.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a territory strategy to achieve and exceed assigned sales targets across New Jersey.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with ophthalmic surgeons, clinical staff, purchasing teams, and other key decision-makers.
* Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities while expanding BVI’s presence within existing accounts.
* Promote BVI’s ophthalmic portfolio by communicating the clinical and commercial value of products to customers and end users.
* Provide product demonstrations and clinical support within customer facilities, including operating room environments where appropriate.
* Analyze territory performance, customer activity, sales data, and competitive intelligence to prioritize opportunities and guide account strategy.
* Use CRM and other sales tools to effectively plan customer interactions, document activities, track opportunities, and maintain accurate account information.
* Partner with Marketing, Clinical Affairs, Customer Service, Operations, and other BVI teams to deliver an effective customer experience and identify opportunities to expand the BVI portfolio.

  

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of successful sales experience within healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or a related industry.
* Experience selling to healthcare professionals, hospitals, ASCs, physician practices, or other healthcare organizations.
* Ophthalmology experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience working with surgical products or technologies.
* Demonstrated success in developing new business while growing and retaining existing customer accounts.
* Strong consultative selling, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with surgeons, clinical staff, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to analyze sales data, manage territory priorities, and use CRM and other sales tools to drive effective account strategies.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout New Jersey, including occasional overnight travel, and to work in clinical and operating-room environments as required.

  

**Company**

BVI® is refocusing the future of vision.
  
  
As one of the fastest-growing, diversified surgical ophthalmic businesses in the world, our purpose-built portfolio of trusted brands includes: Beaver® (Knives and Blades), Visitec® (Cannulas), Malosa® (Single-Use Instruments), Vitreq® (Vitreoretinal Surgical Products) and PhysIOL® (Premium IOLs), and spans more than 90 countries.
  
  
We’ve set our sights on touching the lives of millions of patients affected by conditions such as cataracts, refractive error, glaucoma, retinal disease, and dry eye. Unburdened by legacy or bureaucracy, we have developed our strategy around a simple concept – taking pride in delivering innovative solutions for our physicians and patients, based on their needs. We trust and empower our associates to make decisions and solve problems because collaboration drives us. Valuing agility, simplicity, and transparency, we stay committed to listening to our customers, delivering for our patients, and keeping the future in focus.
  
  
Learn more at www.bvimedical.com

jobs.title: Telephonic Case Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description:

**This is a** **temporary,** **full-time, flexible work from home position** **lasting at least 6 months** **and** **can be located anywhere in the U.S.**

**You must possess a New Jersey RN or LPN License**

**Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, mileage and travel reimbursement, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands-on workers’ compensation case management training.

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:

* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2+ years telephonic clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
  + Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
  + URAC-recognized certification in case management preferred (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN-S, RN-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $71,000 - $72,800 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

jobs.description:

============

Remote, US

**Scheduled Hours**
===================

40

**Position Summary**
====================

The Behavioral Health Care manager serves as a core member of our pediatric collaborative care team, working together with one primary care pediatric practice and a psychiatric consultant to assess pediatric patients' mental health needs, provide brief therapeutic interventions, and coordinate the mental health care of patients on an assigned caseload.

**Job Description**
===================

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Position Title**

Capital Planning & Stress Testing Program Manager

**Location**

Nationwide, MI 48098

**Job Summary**

The Capital Planning & Stress Testing Program Manager leads Flagstar’s stress testing and capital planning processes, reporting to the Director of Capital Planning & Stress Testing. This role coordinates cross-functional teams to execute stress test plans, ensure regulatory compliance, and align with capital management policies. Responsibilities include developing and integrating stress testing processes, overseeing documentation, guiding scenario design, and preparing reports for senior management and regulators. The manager ensures that capital planning is effective, meets governance standards, and supports strategic decisions. This role exists to ensure the bank’s capital planning exercises are executed efficiently, meet regulatory expectations, and support sound strategic decision-making.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Program Leadership & Plan Coordination: Leads the bank’s stress testing program, coordinating input from multiple departments to collect and integrate all necessary data and materials. Maintains and updates key capital planning documents (e.g., capital plan narrative, policies, contingency plans) to ensure the stress testing process is cohesive and aligned with business objectives.
* Scenario Design & Challenge Oversight: Leads internal stress test scenarios informed by the bank’s idiosyncratic risks (Risk ID inventory) and evaluates capital adequacy under adverse conditions. Manages review/challenge sessions on forecasted results (e.g., PPNR, credit losses), addressing key assumptions and limitations through sensitivity analysis and appropriate overlays.
* Reporting & Regulatory Submission: Prepares and submits regulatory stress testing reports and the final capital plan document, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Produces clear summaries of stress test results and recommended capital actions for senior management and Board review and performs ad-hoc capital analyses (such as peer comparisons) to support decision-making.
* Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensures the consistency and reliability of stress test results through strong quality controls and data governance. Maintains an inventory of critical capital planning data elements, working with Data Governance to resolve data issues, and verifies adherence to internal risk management standards. Supports and addresses any findings from regulatory, risk, or internal audits and ensures continuous compliance with all relevant policies and regulatory requirements throughout the stress testing cycle.
* Proactively manage examination requests, company resources, program risks, and required deliverables, as well as the day-to-day planning and resource allocation.
* Responsible for talent management functions including: employment, performance evaluations, staff development/training, disciplinary actions, succession planning and ensuring all staff comply with compliance requirements.

**ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Strategic Alignment: Works under the direction of the CPST Director to ensure that stress testing activities support the bank’s strategic goals for capital adequacy and risk management. Provides input to senior leadership on opportunities to improve capital efficiency or risk mitigation based on stress test insights.
* Governance and Policy Adherence: Upholds the governance framework for capital planning. Ensures that all activities follow the approved Capital Planning & Stress Testing policies and the governance standards set by management committees (CMC, ERMC) and the Board. All documentation and processes should withstand regulatory scrutiny and internal audit standards.
* Continuous Improvement: Stays current on evolving regulatory expectations (e.g., Federal Reserve guidance for Category IV banks, Basel capital standards) and industry best practices in stress testing. Recommends and implements enhancements to the stress testing program, such as process improvements, model updates (in partnership with model development teams), and improved coordination mechanisms, to continually strengthen Flagstar’s capital planning capabilities.
* Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
* Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education level required: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics or a related field (or equivalent work experience in a related discipline).

* Minimum experience required: 6+ Years experience in financial risk management, capital planning, or stress testing. Involvement in enterprise stress testing processes or regulatory capital plan preparation.
* Technical Skills: Knowledge of regulatory capital requirements and stress testing frameworks (e.g., DFAST/CCAR, Basel III). Proficiency in financial modeling and scenario analysis; advanced Excel skills.
* Leadership & Communication: Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects or teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial analyses to senior executives. Collaborative team player who can influence and coordinate stakeholders across departments.
* Analytical & Detail-Oriented: High attention to detail and accuracy. Strong analytical problem-solving skills to interpret model results and identify trends or issues. Effective at managing multiple priorities and deadlines, especially during peak stress testing cycles.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Education level preferred: Master's Degree (or Postgraduate equivalent) in Finance, Business Administration (MBA), Economics, or a related field or profe
