jobs.description:
**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**The Team:**

Upstart’s **Partner Implementation & Enablement** team is responsible for bringing new bank and credit union partners onto our platform and keeping existing partners equipped to run their lending programs. We own the operational core of the partner relationship: the diligence materials partners use to evaluate us, the change management process that tells them when our policies and models change, and the systems that deliver both. How quickly a partner can launch, and how much confidence they have in us once they have launched, is decided by this team’s work.

As the **Diligence Program Lead** at Upstart, you will own the diligence and change management programs our lending partners depend on. You will answer the due diligence questionnaires that partners and their examiners require, maintain the document library and access controls behind them, and run the recurring process that notifies partners when our policies, procedures, and models change. You will work across Compliance, Lending Partnerships, Account Management, and Product to turn a set of manual, individually held processes into programs that hold up as the partner base grows.

**How you’ll make an impact**

* Own the lending partner change management program end to end: assemble each release, notify partners of policy, procedure, and model updates, and keep the supporting document libraries current.
* Respond to lending partner due diligence questionnaires and information requests, working with Compliance, Legal, and Model Risk Management to source and verify every answer.
* Maintain the partner-facing document repository and its access controls, including which materials each partner can reach based on their product mix and stage in the relationship.
* Run the recurring corrective action reporting cycle: validate the source data, distribute partner-specific reports, and confirm delivery with the teams that publish them.
* Work with Product to move manual diligence and change management workflows onto supported tooling, and document each process so more than one person can run it.
* Identify gaps in policy ownership and documentation approval status, and raise them with Compliance and Lending Partnerships before they reach a partner.

**Minimum Qualificationsu**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
* 5 years of experience in financial services compliance, risk, audit, or third-party due diligence
* 2 years of experience responding to due diligence questionnaires, regulatory examinations, or audit requests from banks, credit unions, or other regulated institutions
* Experience owning a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, including its documentation
* Experience administering a document management system, virtual data room, or other controlled-access content repository

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of consumer lending products and the policies that govern them, including personal loans, auto, and home equity
* Knowledge of model risk management practices and how model documentation is shared with third parties

Monday - Friday 11:30am-8pm EST

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success Management
jobs.description:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

As Manager of our Pooled Customer Success team, you will lead a team of 4 to 7 Customer Success Managers who share collective ownership of a large portfolio of customers. Your mandate is to build a high performing team that delivers consistent, measurable value across many accounts without the a named one to one relationship.

This is a different discipline from named account management. Success here comes from designing repeatable plays, prioritizing the right customers at the right moment, maintaining clean account context so any CSM can pick up any customer, and holding the team to response and follow through standards that protect retention at volume.

You are both an operator and a hands on coach. You build the coverage system, you improve it every quarter, and you develop CSMs who can move quickly, diagnose accurately, and create value in a compressed number of touchpoints.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 4 to 7 pooled CSMs supporting a shared customer portfolio.

* Manage workload distribution, queue coverage, and capacity across the team so no customer segment goes unattended.

* Conduct regular portfolio reviews, renewal and risk reviews, and performance check ins.

* Coach CSMs on rapid discovery, efficient customer conversations, and getting to value in fewer, higher quality interactions.

* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

* Hire, onboard, and develop CSM talent suited to a fast moving, high volume environment.

* Driving Measurable Customer Value at Scale

* Operationalize our Customer Value Framework through standardized plays rather than bespoke plans.

* Ensure every customer in the pool receives defined lifecycle coverage, including onboarding confirmation, adoption checkpoints, and a structured pre renewal review.

* Establish clear value milestones and outcome criteria that apply consistently across the portfolio.

* Ensure product adoption is connected to tangible business results in every customer facing interaction.

* Monitor portfolio health signals and direct team effort toward the accounts where intervention changes the outcome.

**Retention, Expansion & Growth Alignment**  

* Own retention performance for the pooled portfolio, including renewal readiness and early risk detection.

* Partner closely with Renewals and Sales leadership on renewal strategy and expansion routing.

* Ensure CSMs surface new use cases, new stakeholders, and expansion signals and hand them off cleanly.

* Influence retention strategy through data driven insights and repeatable risk mitigation plays.

* Operational Excellence & Scalability

* Define and enforce the operating rhythm for the pool, including coverage standards, response expectations, escalation paths, and handoff protocols.

* Ensure documentation discipline so that account context lives in the system, not in individual memory, and any CSM can serve any customer.

* Ensure CRM and CS tooling reflect accurate account health, engagement history, and renewal status.

* Use metrics such as coverage rate, time to first response, adoption, health scores, renewal rates, and expansion ARR to drive performance conversations.

* Identify automation and process improvements that increase capacity without increasing headcount.

* Cross Functional Leadership

* Serve as the voice of a large and diverse customer population internally while balancing business priorities.

* Partner with Support, Product, Professional Services, Renewals, and Sales to improve the customer journey for customers who do not have a dedicated resource.

* Surface systemic risks, adoption blockers, and product feedback trends to senior leadership, using the volume of the pool as an early warning system for the broader base.

* Contribute to strategic planning for the broader Customer Success organization.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, including:

* 3+ years in Customer Success or account management

* 2+ years managing or leading CSM teams

* Experience operating a pooled, shared, or scaled coverage model, or a demonstrated ability to build one.

* Strong understanding of renewal strategy, retention management, and risk identification at volume.

* Proven ability to design and improve repeatable plays, playbooks, and operating standards.

* Comfort managing through systems and data rather than through individual account relationships.

* Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to translate portfolio signals into prioritized team action.

* A leadership style grounded in transparency, ownership, and high standards.

jobs.title: Sales & Operations Leader

***Role summary***

We are hiring a part-time Sales & Operations Leader to run the sales and operations staff across three businesses: BICS (IT and analytics consulting), Evolve (digital marketing), and S&N Investment Properties (real estate). The people doing the work are already in place; this Leader keeps them on process, verifies execution, and drives revenue, close rate, and customer engagement heading into 2027.

***Job responsibilities***

· **Strategic execution:** Translate founder and leadership ideas into a defined objective, owner, next step, timeline, and practical measure of progress. Surface trade-offs when priorities change.

· **Sales leadership and revenue operations:** Review HubSpot visibility, opportunity ownership, follow-up and stalled deals. Join selected sales calls to observe performance, give specific feedback, coach the sales team, and improve discovery and handoffs. The assigned salesperson remains accountable for the call and follow-up.

· **Marketing and outreach:** Drive marketing and outreach to existing BICS and Evolve clients and selected prospects. With no dedicated marketing team, define the audience, offer, message, channels, and next steps; personally build or coordinate the materials and campaigns; and assess what generates useful conversations.

· **RFP and proposal leadership:** Review RFPs for fit, requirements, credibility and quality. Serve as the point person gathering relevant project examples, results, references, technical input and other source material from delivery and leadership so proposals are sufficiently supported. Coordinate revisions with the proposal writer and pursuit owner.

· **Cross-company coordination:** Connect people and decisions across BICS and Evolve when an initiative spans sales, marketing, delivery, finance, or administration. Identify work without a clear owner.

· **Onboarding and handoffs:** Coordinate the operational pieces of new team member and client onboarding, including access, documentation, role expectations and handoffs to the assigned owners. Confirm that outstanding setup steps have an owner and are completed.

· **Operational blocker resolution:** Act as the liaison among administrative, accounting, IT, and other support staff to identify and resolve blockers. Bring the founder a concise decision or escalation when the issue exceeds the role’s authority or available resources.

· **Client engagement:** Maintain direct contact with clients when an introduction, relationship check-in, service concern, expansion conversation, or cross-team coordination would help move work forward. Bring the appropriate sales or delivery owner into follow-up.

· **Operational improvement:** Assess workflows, staffing arrangements, tools, AI, and automation opportunities. Move approved changes into use with an owner, basic validation, and follow-through.

· **Delivery and PM enablement:** Partner with delivery leadership to strengthen handoffs, project visibility, and practical PM standards without creating a large training burden. Delivery leadership retains project and PM management.

***Required traits and skills***

· **Hands-on:** Willing and able to do the work, learn unfamiliar technology, and build new tools or solutions when the business needs them.

· **Comfort with ambiguity:** Works from incomplete context, asks targeted questions, checks assumptions, and brings back a concrete recommendation rather than waiting for a complete brief.

· **Independent judgment and resilience:** Makes practical decisions with incomplete information, explains the reasoning, and remains steady when feedback changes the direction. Adjusts and keeps work moving without relying on the founder for every next step.

· **Commercial and technical fluency:** Understands a small technology services firm well enough to connect client needs, delivery capacity, proposals, CRM activity, and profitability. Deep engineering expertise is unnecessary.

· **Independent follow-through:** Tracks commitments, closes loops across contractors and teams, escalates blockers early, and adapts when circumstances change.

· **Pragmatic systems judgment:** Uses lightweight routines and selective automation to improve reliability without imposing unnecessary meetings, documentation, or software.

Pay: $50.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit modine.com.

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Product Account Manager is the end-to-end business owner for a hyperscale client’s Air Handling Unit (AHU), Air Cooled Chiller (ACC) or Modular Data Center (MDC) product line. This role is accountable for growth, profitability, execution and client satisfaction. This role sits at the intersection of Account Management, Product Lifecycle Management, and Supply Chain Execution, ensuring our roadmap, commercial model, and delivery performance are tightly aligned to the client’s scale, velocity, and expectations. You will drive the book of business through forecast accuracy, pricing discipline, program execution, inventory strategy, and defect-free delivery, while orchestrating cross-functional teams (Sales, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Finance, Legal, and Supplier Management).

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Account & Commercial Ownership:**

* Serve as the primary product-facing contact for the assigned hyperscale product line.
* Lead quoting efforts and RFP/RFQ responses.
* Lead revenue, gross margin and share of wallet targets for the assigned product line.
* Lead commercial negotiations for the product line.
* Own the opportunity pipeline in CRM.
* Build strong relationships within the customer’s organization throughout all cross-functional teams including the engineering, sourcing and program teams to understand needs and drive alignment.
* Support multi-year account planning activities, leveraging the strengths of Modine’s portfolio for the customer’s requirements.

**Product Line Leadership:**

* Define product line strategy & positioning for the client across portfolio mix and lifecycle transitions.

**Forecasting & Demand Planning:**

* Partner with the client and internal planning to build rolling demand and supply plans.

**Program & Delivery Alignment:**

* Collaborate with Program Management, Operations, Finance and Supply Chain to ensure customer expectations are met for delivery, quality and communication.
* Support customer-driven change requests

**Product Feedback & VoC:**

* Serve as the primary voice of the customer for their product line
* Gather customer insights regarding performance, serviceability and future needs.
* Share customer feedback internally to support roadmap development and continuous improvement.

**Required Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field
* Minimum of 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Account Management, Technical Account Management or Sales of highly engineered capital goods to industrial or commercial customers.
* Experience in HVAC&R or data center cooling equipment
* Strong communication, relationship-building and customer engagement skills.
* Ability to collaborate across all internal cross-functional teams

jobs.title: Technical Operations Lead (Web Operations and Security)
jobs.description:
TECHNICAL OPERATIONS LEAD (WEB OPERATIONS & SECURITY)  
Fractional · Fully remote

ABOUT THE ROLE

You keep every website merabi touches online, secure, fast, and correctly configured, and you catch problems before our clients or we do. You also implement our SEO and AI visibility specifications on those sites. You do not set that strategy.

About 70% of this role is infrastructure, security, and development. The rest is implementing search and AI visibility work. If you are an SEO specialist who does some server work, this is not your role. If you are a backend or web operations person who understands how search and AI crawlers read a site, it is.

merabi is a B2B content marketing agency. We manage websites for clients across several industries. Our stack is WordPress (WPBakery, Salient, Yoast), WP Engine, Google Search Console and GA4, ClickUp, and Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Primary: keeping sites running and secure

* Uptime and error monitoring, spotting problems before clients report them
* Security: hosting and cloud hardening, access control, plugin vulnerability management, malware remediation, recovery after a compromise
* Maintenance: core, theme and plugin updates, backups and restore testing, staging environments, Core Web Vitals
* Development: new client site builds, ongoing changes and fixes on live sites
* Incident response: you are the person who fixes it when a site goes down, gets hacked, or breaks after an update
* Internal IT: tooling, access management, credential hygiene across a small remote team

Secondary: implementing our search and AI visibility specifications

* Google Search Console across client properties: index coverage, sitemaps, crawl errors
* Site hygiene: redirects, canonicals, broken links, making sure every page resolves and indexes as intended
* Structured data: deploying the JSON-LD we specify, validating it, fixing what fails
* AI visibility: robots.txt permissions for AI crawlers, verifying pages render for them, monitoring AI referral traffic

We write the SEO, GEO and AEO strategy in house. You implement it, tell us when something we’ve specified won’t work technically, and confirm it is live.

REQUIREMENTS

* Hands-on professional WordPress administration: hosting, staging, migrations, updates, backups, plugin conflicts
* Web and server security: hardening, access control, malware cleanup, recovery from a compromised site
* Development capable of new builds, not just maintenance
* Comfortable owning incident response, including the judgment to escalate versus fix quietly
* Working proficiency in Google Search Console
* Able to read a specification, implement it exactly, and confirm it worked

Working knowledge is enough:

* How indexing, canonicalization and redirects affect search visibility
* Schema and JSON-LD: deploying and validating it, following our strategy
* How AI crawlers and AI search surfaces read a site, and what blocks them
* Core Web Vitals and page performance

Nice to have: SEO strategy, keyword research, copywriting, client-facing account management.

WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GREAT IN THIS ROLE

* You catch things before we do. The single most valuable trait here is noticing a problem on a client site before the client or we notice it.
* You document what you change.
* You are direct about what is broken, including when we are the ones who broke it.

THE ENGAGEMENT

* Fractional, ongoing monthly retainer. Not a project, not full-time employment.
* Starting at 20 hours per month, scaling to 30 or 40 as our client roster grows
* Up to 10 additional hours per month for incidents and unplanned work, approved in advance, billed only when used
* First month around 45 hours, to complete the site inventory and security baseline
* New client website builds and major rebuilds sit outside the retainer and are scoped and quoted per project
* Rate: tell us your hourly rate when you apply
* Fully remote
* Reachable for critical incidents outside normal hours. We are not asking for 24/7 on-call, but a client site down over a weekend needs a response.
* You work directly with Jessica, and with Ana, who handles technical implementation on the content side

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

* Inventory every site we manage: hosting, access, backup status, plugin and update state, known issues
* Apply a security baseline across the portfolio: access control, tested backups, known vulnerabilities closed
* Document an incident response path with agreed response times
* Clear Search Console across all properties: no unresolved index coverage or redirect errors
* Implement and verify our AI visibility specifications on every site

TO APPLY

Email jessica@merabi.co with:

* A short note on a site you inherited in bad shape and what you did about it
* Your hourly rate and your availability per month
* Links or references for work we can look at, or a client who will vouch for how you handle an emergency

Pay: $25.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* IT support: 3 years (Required)
* Web development: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco/San Jose/Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

We’ve built a lot of great resources for employees: onboarding guides, benefits pages, manager how-tos, and hiring FAQs. But we move faster than we document and maintain. We’re growing quickly. Things get out of date, hard to find, or inconsistent in tone. We need someone to own that problem end to end and make sure every piece of employee-facing content is accurate, easy to find, and sounds like it came from the same team.

This isn’t a pure technical writing role, and it isn’t a traditional program management role either. It’s both. You’ll write, design, and edit, but you’ll also audit, organize, and measure. new_jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployments (Life Sciences- Community & Enablement)
new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About Beneficial Deployments**
--------------------------------

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team, focused on helping scientists everywhere get the most from Claude, especially Claude Science. You'll run enablements, workshops and hackathons, build demos that show what frontier models can do for the field, and grow a community of scientists building with Claude. You'll also scale scientific enablement inside Anthropic, so our Applied AI and customer teams can support scientists without you in the room.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Be the DRI for scientific enablement: decide what to run, build the materials, deliver them, and measure whether research teams reach daily use of Claude.
* Lead our programs for activating scientists at scale, such as LSVP and Claude for Researchers: set the goals, design the program and run it.
* Build demos, notebooks and tutorials that show scientists what frontier models can do in their own work, and be an active voice where scientists share tools online (X, LinkedIn, etc.).
* Scale scientific enablement inside Anthropic: train our Applied AI and Customer Success teams, and build playbooks they can run without you.
* Build and lead a scientist community around Claude, and be its ambassador (and support ambassador programs), from small meetups to large conferences.
* Be the voice of scientists inside Anthropic: turn what you hear into concrete asks and see them through to launch, and partner with Marketing and Comms so campaigns and content reach the scientific community.

**You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have**
---------------------------------------

* Deep hands-on expertise with AI tools for science such as Claude Science: you know where they shine and where they break.
* Real credibility as a scientist: hands-on experience doing science in academic labs, biotechs, pharma or research institutes, ideally as a user of the kind of tools you'll help scientists adopt. Experience building or running programs for scientific communities is a plus.
* A track record of helping many scientific teams adopt a new tool through demos, trainings, workshops or hackathons.
* Up to date on AI for science, such as agentic analysis and AI co-scientists, and able to explain it to working scientists.
* Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you can prototype a working demo. You don't need to write production code.
* Clear written and spoken communication: talks, tutorials and docs that scientists find useful.
* A track record of taking programs or products from idea to results: you set the direction, did the work and were accountable for the outcome, often with no playbook.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$275,000 - $315,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

new_jobs.title: Staff Customer Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Staff Customer Operations Manager, you will lead Crusoe's customer feedback ecosystem and use it to shape strategy and operations. You will unify customer and market signals, build a comprehensive view of our customer base, monitor the competitive landscape, and deliver evidence-backed recommendations to executive leadership.

This role connects intelligence to business outcomes. You will track how AI models are evolving and what those shifts mean for GPU demand and our Managed Intelligence offerings, prepare executive customer updates for Cloud Leadership, bring customer evidence into Product and Engineering planning, and build the business case for where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Design and scale the systems that capture, triage, and route customer feedback, including the taxonomy, quality standards, and a central repository of customer evidence
* Own executive update cadences for Cloud Leadership, including the quarterly Voice of Customer executive briefing and Monthly Business Reviews, tracking wins, customer experience signals, and operational updates across the CX team
* Identify where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience based on customer demand, market analysis, and cost to serve
* Advocate for customers in Product and Engineering planning with evidence-based insights, and track the lifecycle of each request from intake through prioritization, delivery, and adoption
* Build the business case for new service offerings and lead their incubation through launch
* Support go-to-market teams with account reviews, customer-specific analysis, and targeted research
* Maintain a comprehensive view of Crusoe's customers, covering segmentation, adoption, and infrastructure footprint, and flag risks such as churn, along with expansion opportunities and behavioral shifts, to account teams
* Monitor competing GPU cloud and inference platforms, including product releases, pricing, and service commitments
* Track AI models across their lifecycle, from frontier and open-weight releases through fine-tuning, serving, and retirement, and map which models and workloads customers train and serve on Crusoe
* Explain what model shifts, such as new architectures, longer context windows, lower-precision formats, and new inference engines, mean for GPU demand, Managed Inference offerings, and account risk

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8+ years in customer operations, Voice of Customer, CX or product strategy, or consulting, translating customer feedback into operational changes
* Technical fluency in AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, or developer tooling, with the ability to read technical documentation, support tickets, and release notes
* Ability to separate true technical differentiation from marketing claims
* Strong executive writing skills for memos, briefs, and recommendations
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority
* Comfortable building operating frameworks and processes in ambiguous environments
* Hands-on experience prototyping and operationalizing workflows with AI tools
* Experience at an AI lab, GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or inference platform
* Background in building competitive intelligence or Voice of Customer programs
* Skill in translating technical insights into a business case

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 - $190,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

new_jobs.title: Talent Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Re:Build**
------------------

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)*

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

Re:Build seeks a hands-on Recruiting Operations Manager to architect and build our AI-enabled talent acquisition function. **Your most important qualification is expert-level experience deploying reliable AI workflows that deliver measurable results, not just using AI tools or creating demonstrations.**

We have budget, internal resources, and support from our Digital Innovation Group. Our technology environment includes but does not have to be limited to **Greenhouse ATS, Clay, LinkedIn Recruiter, Textio, and Criteria.**

**What you get to do**
----------------------

* **AI architecture and delivery:** Own the roadmap from workflow design and prototyping through deployment, adoption, and improvement. Determine when to configure, integrate, buy, or build.
* **Conversational AI:** Deploy hiring-team and candidate-facing agents for requisition intake, process guidance, scheduling, and updates, with authorized system actions and human handoffs.
* **Recruiting infrastructure:** Own system configuration, integrations, data quality, documentation, and vendor performance; reduce administrative work and unnecessary tools.
* **Analytics and planning:** Partner with Finance on workforce planning. Track on-time hiring against fill dates set at requisition opening, recruiter capacity, user experience, costs, and AI impact.
* **Team enablement:** Partner with recruiters, hiring leaders, Digital Innovation, and IT to build practical AI capabilities and turn prototypes into adopted, supported workflows.
* **Responsible deployment:** Establish testing, monitoring, access controls, data protection, accessibility, and fairness safeguards, preserving human accountability for hiring decisions.

**What you bring to the Team**
------------------------------

* Personally delivered multiple AI-enabled workflows into sustained use, including recruiting applications, with measurable results.
* Production experience with conversational agents, trusted knowledge sources, connected systems, multi-step tasks, and human escalation.
* Hands-on fluency with APIs, webhooks, structured data, automation platforms, and AI-assisted development; able to build independently and guide technical partners.
* Strong recruiting operations, analytics, and change-management expertise, with the judgment to distinguish technology needs from process or capacity issues.

**Experience that would be especially valuable**
------------------------------------------------

Experience with our tools, manufacturing, engineering, skilled-trades, or multi-business recruiting is valuable. Exact-tool experience does not replace demonstrated AI implementation expertise.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Less administrative work, better hiring-team and candidate experiences, stronger workforce visibility, and measurable gains in speed, quality, service, and cost, with reliable solutions people use.

**How we will assess your experience**
--------------------------------------

Be prepared to discuss two production deployments: what you personally built, reliability and adoption, measurable impact, and lessons learned. Demonstrated delivery matters more than years using a particular AI product.

  

Compensation (Exempt)

The base salary range for this position is $160k - $190k per year. This range represents the Company's good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. new_jobs.title: Senior Facilities Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Summary**

The **Senior Facilities Operations Manager** is responsible for the day-to-day facilities' soft services operations across Nextpower’s U.S. offices, ensuring each location is clean, functional, well-supported, and ready for daily business operations.

The role leads site-based office operations personnel and manages the delivery of facilities soft services, including reception and front-of-house operations, janitorial and day porter services, pantry and food services, office supplies, mail and shipping, conference and common-area readiness, waste and recycling, and other day-to-day office services.

This position serves as the primary operational interface between office occupants and the Facilities organization, ensuring facility-related requests and issues are identified, appropriately routed, communicated, and followed through to resolution.

The Senior Facilities Operations Manager works closely with Facilities Managers who retain responsibility for hard facilities and technical building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, building controls, infrastructure, etc. This position coordinates the operational impact of that work and ensures continuity of office operations but does not replace the technical responsibilities of the Facilities Managers.

The role partners with Facilities, Real Estate, IT, EHS, Security, Procurement, HR and landlords/property managers among others to maintain consistent facilities service standards across the U.S. portfolio.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in facilities operations, facilities services, corporate office operations, building services, or multi-site facilities environments.
* 5+ years of experience managing Office Managers, facilities coordinators, reception/front-of-house teams, day porters, or other site-based facilities operations personnel.
* Demonstrated experience managing the **day-to-day operation and service delivery** of corporate offices, including reception, janitorial, pantry/food service, office supplies, mail/shipping, conference rooms, common areas, and other facilities soft services.
* Experience establishing and maintaining consistent facilities operating standards, service levels, procedures, and inspection programs across multiple locations.
* Strong experience managing facilities service vendors, contracts, performance, service levels, and corrective actions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage staffing, scheduling, coverage, employee performance, accountability, and development of site operations teams.
* Experience working closely with IT, EHS, HR and Facilities Managers on r hard-facilities issues.
* Ability to recognize facilities issues, determine the appropriate escalation path, coordinate with technical resources, communicate impacts to office occupants, and follow issues through resolution.
* Experience coordinating office moves, restacks, openings, expansions, renovations, furniture changes, and other facilities-related operational changes.
* Experience managing facilities operating budgets, purchase orders, invoices, vendor contracts, forecasts, and operating expenses.
* Strong service orientation combined with the ability to maintain operational standards, accountability, consistency, and cost control.
* Strong communication and relationship-management skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, executives, Facilities Managers, landlords, vendors, and cross-functional teams.
* Highly organized, hands-on, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple locations and competing operational priorities.
Ability to travel regularly among assigned U.S. facilities.  

  

Pay is based on market location and may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education and other job-related reasons. The annual salary range for this position is $150,000.00-$1700,000.00.

Barry’s is the Best Workout in the WorldTM®. Founded in West Hollywood in 1998, it’s the original strength and cardio interval fitness experience that provides an immersive, high-intensity, one-hour workout that’s as effective as it is fun. Our fitness classes alternate between working out with weights and running on a treadmill. Each day focuses on a different muscle group in order to achieve real results and to prevent injuries. Our program is designed to tone muscle and maximize fat loss, while spiking the metabolism for up to 48 hours following the class.

Please be aware that smoking is prohibited in all indoor areas of Barry’s studios and corporate offices.

As a Client Operations Supervisor, you’ll be the first contact for Barry’s, leading best in class Hospitality and execution of daily operations. You will support the Senior/General Manager and Assistant General Manager with key marketing initiatives, team development, upholding brand standards and maintaining all studio facilities. You will lead hospitality, assist clients with class selections, membership queries, Fuel Bar orders and retail. Your passion for customer service and building a strong Barry’s community sets you apart from the rest.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead on duty, ensuring seamless class check-ins, studio opening and closing in accordance with all policies and procedures
* Support management of studio staff on duty
* Develop effective and cooperative relationships with clients/staff
* Support the S/GM and AGM with studio Marketing strategy. This may include:
* Acquisition tactics
* Client and community initiatives
* Studio and team engagement
* Corporate lead generation and outreach
* Assist with fuel bar and retail inventory control and counts
* Partner with S/GM and AGM to support the implementation and execution of all hospitality processes, ensuring all team members have been consistently trained and their skills are continuously developed
* Train and provide ongoing development to team members in service of ensuring a consistent client experience and upholding our mission, vision, values, and hospitality standards
* Oversee milestone, loyalty, and surprise and delight program implementation and execution in studio, celebrating special events with regularity, in accordance with guidelines to drive community and retention

**Manage studio systems:**

* Zendesk
* Brandbot
* Ensure all client matters are properly and swiftly resolved or escalated, and ensure consistent and adequate follow through to all client inquiries
* Assess client needs, maintain quality standards for services, and evaluate client satisfaction while communicating any studio promotions and/or special events
* Lead with prompt and effective internal and external communication

**Maintaining brand standards and all studio facilities responsibilities including but not limited to:**

* Laundry, Red Room maintenance, Locker Room cleaning, overall studio cleanliness
* In partnership with S/GM, AGM or Facilities Lead carry out weekly studio facilities walk-throughs and audits
* Retail and Fuel Bar customer service delivery
* Fuel Bar pre and post class orders
* Merchandising
* Maintaining brand standards
* Identifying opportunities to drive sales and elevate the client experience

**Company Culture Responsibilities:**

* Work to uphold Barry’s community and culture standards, and live the company mission, vision, and values daily.
* Represent the Barry’s brand within the studio and throughout the fitness community.
* Assist in participating in and enhancing the community with your studio and regional teams.

**Required Experience:**

* Strong customer service skills
* Availability to work 5 shifts including weekends and public holidays
* Friendly, outgoing personality and enjoy social interaction
* Exhibits enthusiasm for the studio and for the job
* Must be a patient, courteous listener, able to show empathy
* Responding to clients request with a can-do attitude
* Cooperative manner with an optimistic attitude
* Ability to prioritize and work within a fast-paced environment
* Have an eye for detail and care for the studio’s appearance and cleanliness
* Effective team player
* Maintain a professional appearance and behavior
* Demonstrate excellent communication skills
* Candidates must be at least 18 years or older to apply

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
26 - 26 USD per hour(FiDi)

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful planning, execution, and delivery of projects within budget and on schedule. Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.

**Our Organizational Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth & Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity & Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable & Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity & Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**  

* 18+ for elementary programs; 21+ for middle school programs.
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:

o 48+ completed college units (verified by transcript),  
o Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or  
o Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.  

* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field OR equivalent professional and community experience.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.

**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at local elementary and middle schools. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school-year schedule.

  

**Part-Time and Full-Time opportunities are available for After School Program Dates**:

* San Francisco Sites: August 10, 2026 – June 2, 2027
* Marin Sites: August 17, 2026 – June 11, 2027

**Job Responsibilities**

  

**Curriculum Development & Program Delivery**

* Design and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme-based curricula that reflect the developmental stages and cultural backgrounds of youth.
* Facilitate academic enrichment, tutoring, and structured outdoor recreational activities.
* Partner with staff, caregivers, and participants to plan and enhance program offerings.  
  **Supervision & Safety**
* Supervise groups of up to 20 students, ensuring a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment in alignment with YMCA and child safety protocols.
* Actively monitor participants, respond promptly to incidents, and consistently apply safety guideline  
  **Record-Keeping & Compliance**
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety documentation  
  **Communication & Engagement**
* Communicate clearly and respectfully with participants, caregivers, staff, and volunteers to support a positive program experience.  
  **Training & Development**
* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

  

**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

* This job description may not be all-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.

* Job offers are conditional and contingent upon background clearance. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and CA Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

  

**Salary Description**

The After School Program Leader position offers a compensation range of $24.00 – $25.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

**About Amprius**

Amprius Technologies (NYSE: AMPX) is a leader in high-energy, high-power lithium-ion batteries built on silicon anode technology. Our SiCore® and SiMaxx™ cells power unmanned aerial systems, aviation and other applications where weight and energy density matter most. Headquartered in Fremont, California, Amprius designs cells in house and produces them through a global network of contract manufacturing partners.

**The role**

We are looking for a Senior Quality Manager to own quality across Amprius, from incoming materials and contract manufacturers to the cells we ship to customers. You will lead our quality management system, earn and maintain AS9100 certification, and build a supplier and CM quality program that grows with our manufacturing network. Reporting to Managing Director, Operations. Travel up to 20%, including supplier and CM sites in Asia.

**What you will do**

**Quality management system**

* Own the QMS and lead Amprius through AS9100 certification, then maintain it through surveillance audits.
* Set quality policy, objectives and metrics, and report quality performance to leadership.
* Own document control and records requirements, in partnership with the PLM and change control rollout.

**Supplier and CM quality**

* Build the supplier quality program: audits, qualification, PPAP or first-article approval and ongoing monitoring.
* Publish quarterly scorecards (yield, cost, on-time delivery) for every active supplier and CM.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to fast closure and prevent repeat issues.
* Support new CM and second-source qualifications with Supply Chain.

**Cell quality and certification**

* Make sure every shipping product is tested and certified before shipment (UN 38.3, IEC 62133 and customer requirements).
* Lead incoming, in-process and outgoing inspection and test strategy at Fremont and at CMs.
* Lead customer quality: complaints, returns, failure analysis and 8D reports.

Continuous improvement and team

* Run Lean and Six Sigma improvement projects with measurable savings.
* Hire and develop the quality team, including supplier quality engineers assigned to specific CMs and material families.

 **Requirements**

**What you bring**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, materials science or a related technical field.
* 10+ years in quality for manufactured hardware, including 4+ years managing quality teams.
* Has led an organization through AS9100 or ISO 9001 certification as the QMS owner.
* Strong supplier quality background: audits, PPAP or FAI, and CAPA and 8D methods.
* Skilled with core quality tools: FMEA, control plans, SPC and MSA.

**Nice to have**

* Lithium-ion cell or battery quality, including UN 38.3 and IEC 62133 testing.
* Quality oversight of contract manufacturers, especially in Asia.

**Appointment Type:** This is a Temporary Provisional (TPV) position excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process. It is considered "at will" and shall serve at the discretion of the Department Head. This position will be subject to the Permanent Civil Service examination process at a later date. Successful participation in the Permanent Civil Service examination and selection through an open competitive process is needed in order to be considered for the permanent appointment.

**Application Opening:** October 7, 2026

**Application Deadline:** May close anytime but not before October 22, 2026, at 11:59 PM (PST)

**Compensation Range:** $129,636 - $157,612 annually

**Recruitment ID:** RTF0168077-01142975

**Who We Are**

Through the provision of coordinated, compassionate, and high‐quality services, the Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH) strives to make homelessness in San Francisco rare, brief, and one-time. The Department provides assistance and support to homeless and at‐risk youth, adults and families to prevent imminent episodes of homelessness and end homelessness for people in San Francisco. Services including outreach, homelessness prevention, emergency shelter, drop‐in centers, transitional housing, supportive housing, short‐term rental subsidies, and support services to help people exit homelessness. For more information on the department, please visit our https://hsh.sfgov.org/.

**What We Do**

San Francisco is a pioneer in homeless services and a leader in providing supportive housing as a permanent exit from homelessness. The Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH), founded in 2016, is a national leader in the movement to end homelessness by developing a coordinated, equity-driven, client-focused system of compassionate services while piloting innovative models, and implementing best practice solutions with measurable results.

HSH’s Homelessness Response System (HRS) funds, oversees and implements a system of care that shelters, houses, and serves approximately 15,000 people daily. Major programs include: street outreach and service connection through the Homeless Outreach Team (SFHOT); 3,600 +bed shelter system for transitional age youth, adults and families including shelters for members of the LGBTQ community; rapid rehousing rental subsidies for families, adults, older adults, and transitional aged youth; the Problem Solving and flexible financial assistance programs; and robust supportive housing programs with over 14,500 units which provide housing and services to formerly homeless transitional age youth, individuals, and families.

 **Job Description**

The Continuum of Care (CoC) Program Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing the CoC Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) projects that receive rental assistance, supportive services, operating, and administrative budget line items. On an annual basis, the San Francisco Continuum of Care receives over $48 million in funds from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) to administer CoC programs administered by the San Francisco Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing.

The CoC Program Manager supervises staff who work on compliance related to verification of CoC PSH program eligibility, income certifications and recertifications, and the coordination of Housing Quality Standards (HQS) inspections. The position reports to the CoC Program Supervisor and is a member of the Continuum of Care team at HSH.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Supervises and manages the performance of staff
* Under general direction, oversees a portfolio of CoC-program related units and/or services, regularly communicating with stakeholders to provide technical support related to CoC program compliance, contracting, and invoicing.
* Reviews and approves forms and documents related to CoC subsidy billing, such as CoC Rental Assistance Invoice review, Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) Contracts, HAP Contract Amendments, Vacancy Loss Claims, and Property Damage Claims, and security deposits.
* Regularly provides input on program and policy development of CoC team, including the CoC Operations manual, the CoC Subsidy Termination Policy, and the CoC and ESG Desk Guide.
* Proposes and provides solutions to problems that arise within the portfolio, including developing and implementing systems and best practices to support achievement of departmental and grant goals.
* Program manages grant agreements – develops the scope of services and budget for agreements; reviews budget revisions; reviews and submits budget modification requests; and participates in program monitoring.
* Performs analyses on grant utilization and spend down, including other statistical analyses and reports to inform policy and funding decisions to improve on‐going operations of CoC PSH programs and other activities related to the CoC PSH portfolio.
* Reviews invoices and reports in the Contracts Administration, Reporting, and Billing Online (CARBON) system and update CARBON.
* Actively participates in the development, implementation and ongoing operations of the Coordinated Entry (CE) process and the Online Navigation and Entry (ONE) system.
* Addresses backlog issues with verification of CoC eligibility, coordination of HQS inspections, HAP Contracts, etc.
* Assists the CoC Program Supervisor and the CoC Manager in drafting memoranda to CoC grant subrecipients.
* Communicates with CoC tenants on ADA grievances and/or concerns related to CoC program policy.
* Represents the HSH CoC team in projects involving mass relocation of CoC tenants
* Drafts formal correspondence to stakeholders, including contracted providers and tenants.
* Represents the department at community and professional meetings; and leads and/or coordinates work groups and meetings with staff, providers, and/or other stakeholders to assure smooth operations of the vario

new_jobs.title: Account Manager, SME & Growth
new_jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

**About the team**
------------------

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

Airwallex is looking for an Account Manager to manage and grow a substantial portfolio of US-based small and medium customers. You will build trusted relationships with founders, CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders while helping customers maximize the value of Airwallex's global financial platform.

You will use customer insight, product knowledge, and account data to increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and support smooth ongoing operations. This role combines consultative account management, revenue growth, customer advocacy, and cross-functional problem solving across a diverse portfolio of approximately 200 accounts.

We are a hybrid working environment with 3 days per week in the office (SF, NYC).

### **Responsibilities:**

* Identify and convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts by using customer feedback, usage data, and account signals to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.
* Manage a diverse book of approximately 200 US-based accounts, including businesses that operate across multiple countries, and develop a clear understanding of each customer's goals, operating model, and financial workflows.
* Serve as the go-to expert on the Airwallex platform, helping customers maximize the value of core products and adopt additional solutions such as FX, Cards, Online Payments, and other relevant products.
* Build lasting relationships with CFOs, CEOs, founders, and other key decision makers through consultative conversations, regular business reviews, and ongoing engagement focused on customer outcomes.
* Partner with Account Executives, Customer Success, Strategy and Operations, Marketing, Product, Risk, Support, and other internal teams to resolve customer challenges, improve the client experience, and maximize platform utilization.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally by communicating emerging needs, product feedback, operational issues, and opportunities to improve Airwallex's products and processes.

**Who you are**
---------------

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* 4+ years of account management or software sales experience in technology, SaaS, fintech, payments, or a related industry.
* Strong sales skills, including value-based solution selling, commercial judgment, and the ability to navigate complex sales cycles.
* Demonstrated success managing a substantial book of business and driving revenue growth through account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, or product adoption.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to build trust and present effectively to CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders.
* Experience using Salesforce or another CRM, together with spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar tools to organize account data, prioritize opportunities, and manage customer activity.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, API sales, or other technology serving merchants and internationally operating businesses.
* Experience acting as a strategic payments or financial technology advisor, using data and customer insight to explain business value and influence customer decisions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an organized and methodical approach to managing a high-volume portfolio.
* Proven ability to work with ownership, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including the ability to figure things out and collaborate across functions.

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters**
-------------------------------------------------------------

*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official

**Who We Are**
--------------

Parakeet Health is building the AI-powered operating system for medical practices. Today, healthcare runs on phone calls, faxes, and manual labor, and everyone feels it. Practices burn through staff juggling inbound calls, chasing referrals, and filling last-minute cancellations, while patients sit on hold, wait weeks to hear back, and fall through the cracks when overloaded teams can't keep up.

Our conversational AI agents replace that entire layer: answering patient calls and texts 24/7, booking appointments, processing faxed referrals, and proactively reaching out to patients who need care. The result is practices that run leaner, and patients receive more personalized care whenever they need it.

We’re an ambitious team of seasoned healthcare veterans (One Medical, Commure, R1) and builders (Stripe, Rippling, Google, DoorDash, Microsoft). Our customers include national primary care, specialty, and urgent care medical groups with footprints in all 50 states. We've handled millions of patient interactions to date and are scaling rapidly.

**The Role**
------------

Our customers have grown rapidly, and we’re expanding the Customer Experience team with a second **Customer Success Manager** to ensure our growing client base gets the care they need and sees the value our platform delivers.

You’ll own the full post-sale relationship for a portfolio of specialty healthcare practices—from kick-off through ongoing success. That means running kick-off calls, leading training sessions, monitoring customer health, troubleshooting issues, and making sure customers feel genuinely supported every step of the way.

* **Turn Feedback Into Product:** You’re the frontline observer of how our AI performs in the real world. Translate client feedback and operational data into clear, actionable insights for Product and Engineering. The feedback you surface directly shapes what we build.
* **Solve Problems, Don’t Just Flag Them:** When something breaks, you will investigate root causes, propose a fix, and often implement the solution yourself before escalating. You operate with urgency and ownership.

**Who You Are**
---------------

3 to 6 years of experience in customer success, account management, or consulting—ideally in health tech or SaaS.

* **Personable**: You build genuine relationships quickly. Clients trust you because you’re warm, responsive, and clearly invested in their success. You can distill complexity into business value for everyone from the front-desk staff to the C-suite.
* **Builder Mentality:** You don’t wait for a playbook—you write it. You’re energized by ambiguity, take full ownership from day one, and thrive when you’re building something from scratch at an early-stage company. You exercise good judgment without needing rigid guidance.
* **AI-Fluent & Curious:** You already use LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) daily and are always looking for new ways to apply AI to your work. You treat these tools as a force multiplier, not a novelty.
* **Technical-Enough:** You’re comfortable with EHR integrations, APIs, and workflows. You can troubleshoot basic issues before escalating and translate product value for both technical and business stakeholders. You’ve used tools like Retool, Salesforce, HubSpot, and data platforms (Metabase, SQL, or strong Excel/Sheets).
* **Strong project management instincts:** you’ll be juggling multiple implementations and client relationships at once.
* **Comfortable being uncomfortable:** skilled at receiving client feedback gracefully and turning it into action, even when the product is still evolving.
* **Proactive and results-oriented:** you anticipate risks and opportunities rather than waiting for them to find you.
* **Proven track record of results:** experience driving adoption, retention, and expansion (NRR, upsell, or account growth—not just keeping the lights on).
