new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
new_jobs.description:
Prelim is growing 2-3x annually and our platform powers account opening and onboarding for banks across the country. Our team is at a turning point: the informal systems that got us here won't scale with where we're headed next.

Today, the work of coordinating across teams, tracking delivery, and keeping the company’s operational rhythm falls on the founder — who is also our head of product — and on the leads themselves. That’s not sustainable and we know it.

As our first Business Operations hire, you’ll build the operational infrastructure Prelim runs on. There’s no playbook and no predecessor. You’ll decide what to systematize first, build processes that scale, and manage our two technical account managers.

**What You'll Own**

* **The company operating system.** You'll build and run the lightweight systems that give leadership a weekly view of who's working on what, team load, and delivery risk across product and implementations. When a new bank comes in, you're the person who looks at current allocation, identifies who has capacity, and presents staffing options — not the founder doing it from memory in a Slack DM. You surface stalled projects, overloaded teams, and unanswered customer concerns before they become emergencies.
* **Our technical account management team.** Our two TAMs report to you. You'll hold regular 1:1s, track goals, provide feedback, and develop them. You own their workload and development; the founders retain executive ownership of bank relationships and account strategy.
* **Staffing and project coordination.** When projects need to be reassigned, when someone goes out of office, when a customer issue needs routing to the right lead, you make sure the handoff happens and nothing gets dropped. You maintain the map of who covers what. And when an implementation goes sideways, the lead who owns it runs the recovery. Your job is making sure every client concern has an owner, a plan, and a next check-in date, and that nothing quietly goes dark. If a project stalls or has no owner, you flag it before the client does.
* **Operational rhythm.** Lead syncs have agendas. Cycle kickoffs happen on a schedule. Commitments from meetings get tracked and followed up on. You own the cadence that keeps the company running smoothly.
* **Vendor and logistics management.** You’ll collaborate with People Operations on software contracts, offsites, and team meetups.

**What You** ***Won't*** **Own**

You won't recover client projects yourself — our leads own recovery on their accounts; you own making sure recovery is happening. You won't own client strategy or the executive relationship with our banks — account health, expansion, and voice-of-customer stay with the founder. You're not making product decisions — the founder and product leads own the roadmap, though what you see in the operating data should shape it. And beyond our two TAMs, you're not a people manager — team leads manage their own reports.

**What We're Looking For**

* **4-6 years spanning delivery leadership and business operations**, including a leadership role at a B2B software company or a smaller group in a larger tech company.
* **You've personally done the work at least once.** You've run complex enterprise implementations or owned technical accounts yourself, recently enough that your teams will trust your judgment in an client-facing communications.
* **You're a strong writer and communicator.** The operational documentation, staffing plans, and status rhythms don't exist yet; you'll create them, and they'll only work if they're clear and concise.
* **You're relentlessly organized without being bureaucratic.** You add just enough structure that things don't fall through cracks, and you know the difference between useful process and process for its own sake.
* **You're direct and unintimidated.** You'll tell a lead their team is overloaded, and you'll tell the founder he committed to something we don't have capacity for.

**Nice to Have, Not Required**

* Experience in fintech or selling into banks
* Familiarity with tools like Linear, Notion, Pylon, Mixpanel
* Experience supporting a technical team (engineering, design, implementations)

**What You Won't Find in This Role**

A mature org to administer. You'll work directly with the founder daily, interim structures, and make the org-design decisions a founder has been making from memory. The decisions you make will directly determine the reach and scope of our mission.

**How You'll Know It's Working**

A month in, the founder stops being the person asking "who's covering this." Three months in, there's a weekly load-and-risk snapshot leadership relies on, and every implementation has a clear owner and status. Six months in, a new bank's staffing conversation takes fifteen minutes, client concerns have an owner who isn't the founder.

**About Prelim**

Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation.

We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company retreats. This role would also attend periodic team meetups in NYC and SF.

Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

Compensation Range: $240K - $260K

* High School diploma/GED equivalent required.
* Customer service background preferred.
* Basic computer proficiency.
* Punctuality and reliability are a must.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* A positive, upbeat attitude and a passion for fitness and health!
* Exceptional customer service skills; able to interact in a positive and professional way with members and co-workers, exceeding the member’s expectations.

**Physical Demands**  

* Continual standing and walking during shift.
* Continual talking in person or on the phone during shift.
* Must be able to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs.

**About Us**
============

Taymax Group, LP is a multi-unit franchisee of Planet Fitness, which is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness clubs in North America. Taymax owns and operates over 175 clubs in California, Texas, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and Ontario and the Atlantic Provinces in Canada, and has plans to double its club count over the next 5 years. Taymax is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisees in the Planet Fitness system, consistently experiencing double digit growth per year. Taymax is backed by Trilantic North America, a New York-based private equity firm managing $9.9 billion of aggregate capital commitments. Taymax has been the recipient of several prestigious awards from the franchisor including Developer of the Year in 2016, 2018, and 2019 and Franchisee of the Year in 2018. Taymax’s corporate office is located in Salem, New Hampshire.

With more than 2,000 locations, Planet Fitness (NYSE: PLNT) is one of the largest and most popular fitness chains in the world. Planet Fitness possesses a highly recognized brand in the high-value, low-price segment of the market. Its core mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which it calls the Judgement Free Zone®. More than 90% of Planet Fitness stores are owned and operated by independent franchisees, like Taymax.

NOTE: Only those applicants under consideration will be contacted. Please accept our utmost appreciation for your interest in a position with Taymax Group.

Taymax Group is an equal opportunity employer in the terms and conditions of employment. We believe in providing an inclusive and diverse workplace environment and welcome talent from all backgrounds and perspectives. Our success is directly related to our people and as a company, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse environment where we all work toward our common goal; to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone. This commitment applies to all candidates and employees regardless of race, color, ethnicity, citizenship, place of origin, creed, religion, age, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, family status, marital status, disability and any other protected characteristic.

Taymax Group welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Further, we recommend that you do not provide sensitive personal information (SSN, DOB, driver’s license number) as part of the initial application process.

new_jobs.description:
**Join Our Talent Network**  
This is an evergreen job posting, meaning we are always interested in connecting with exceptional talent who possess the skillsets required for the role. Although a specific opening may not currently be available, your application allows our recruiting team to consider you for future opportunities that align with your skills and experience.  
  
**Role Overview**  
As a Project Manager you will oversee multiple active residential roofing and siding crews while helping deliver best-in-class customer service to homeowners throughout our Brands’ service areas. You will manage projects from start to finish, coordinate installation crews and subcontractors, and serve as a primary point of contact for customers during installation.

This role offers a long-term career opportunity with paths for growth in compensation, responsibility, and leadership based on performance and ambition. You will help ensure each project meets expectations for schedule, budget, quality, property protection, documentation, and customer communication.

You will be part of a very collaborative, very agile team working collectively to fulfill our mission of saving our communities from unscrupulous contractors. We promise an open and transparent environment where you’ll be surrounded by highly intelligent people all working together towards a common goal.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and coordinate residential roofing and siding projects from start to finish.
* Supervise subcontractors and installation crews on-site.
* Maintain effective communication with clients throughout the project and serve as the primary company
* contact during installation.
* Oversee proper protection of customers’ homes and properties during construction.
* Ensure project timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met.
* Maintain accurate project documentation using computer and project-tracking tools.

**Requirements**

* Prior field-force site supervision experience; minimum 1 year preferred.
* Strong leadership and communication skills; bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.
* Valid driver’s license and insurable driving record.
* Basic proficiency with computers and project-tracking tools.

**Benefits**

* Performance-based and project-completion bonus opportunities.
* 401(k) with company match following one year of service.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Paid time off.
* Opportunities for professional growth and leadership development.

**About Us**  
Infinity Home Services (“IHS”) was founded by Wisconsin entrepreneurs with a simple but ambitious goal: to raise the standard of residential roofing and exterior remodeling and “Save our Communities from Unscrupulous Contractors.”

Today, we are recognized as a leader in our industry delivering exceptional roofing, windows, and siding installation services using only the most trusted, top‑quality materials.

Our platform brings together a family of respected local brands, empowering each to enhance service delivery, strengthen community presence, and expand market share. We stand behind every job we perform, using top quality materials, best‑in‑class installation practices, and an ongoing commitment to do the right thing.

IHS is rapidly expanding both organically and through strategic acquisitions. As we shape the future of the Home Services industry, we seek ethical, forward‑thinking professionals who bring innovation, integrity, and craftsmanship to their roles. The work we perform directly protects our customers’ most important investment, their homes!

IHS is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

With a focus on foresight and innovative technology, we empower organizations to anticipate challenges and seize opportunities through advanced predictive intelligence systems.

**Overview**

Kiona is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead complex business transformation initiatives. In this role, you will drive cross-functional projects that enable operational improvement, organizational change, and measurable business value.

Successful candidates bring structure to ambiguity, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and create accountability across diverse stakeholder groups. You know how to leverage subject matter expertise, navigate competing priorities, and keep teams focused on delivering results without assuming ownership of business or technical decisions.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stakeholders trust your reporting because it is accurate, transparent, and actionable.
* Risks, dependencies, and issues are addressed proactively rather than reactively.
* Ambiguity surrounding ownership, decisions, and commitments is resolved quickly.
* You bring solutions and recommendations, not just problems.
* Business and technical leaders retain decision ownership while you drive execution.
* Projects are delivered against agreed commitments and business outcomes are realized.
* Teams seek to work with you again because of your leadership, organization, and accountability.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
* Experience leading business transformation, process improvement, organizational change, or enterprise initiatives.

* Proven ability to perform effectively in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and evolving requirements.

**Why this role matters**  
As a key member of the Infrastructure Program team, you'll lead delivery of a large-scale infrastructure efficiency, consolidation and decommissioning program across a complex telecommunications estate.

You'll coordinate infrastructure consolidation, energy-efficiency initiatives, DC power optimization, cooling efficiency, network shutdown and site exits. Your job is to bring multiple technical and operational workstreams together to deliver measurable energy, cost and infrastructure reductions with minimal operational disruption.

You'll be the central program owner, working across Infrastructure, Network Operations, Energy Efficiency, Engineering, Real Estate, Field Operations and external suppliers.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of the infrastructure efficiency, consolidation and decommissioning program

* Coordinate network shutdown, migration and legacy equipment decommissioning

* Manage program RAID, governance, budgets, forecasts and supplier performance
* Coordinate internal engineering teams, field resources, OEMs and third-party partners
* Track and report measurable benefits, including energy, infrastructure and operating cost reductions
* Provide clear reporting to senior stakeholders on progress, risks, finances and benefits
* Support business cases for infrastructure replacement, retrofit, reuse and recovery
* Maintain operational controls when working on live telecommunications infrastructure

**What we're looking for**

* Proven experience as a Program Manager or Senior Program Manager delivering complex infrastructure programs
* Background in telecommunications, data centers, critical infrastructure or similar environments
* Experience with large-scale consolidation, decommissioning, transformation or site-exit programs
* Strong understanding of DC power infrastructure and telecom rectifier environments
* Understanding of energy efficiency, power consumption and cooling optimization
* Experience coordinating multi-site field delivery and decommissioning
* Strong program governance, RAID, financial and benefits-management skills
* Strong analytical skills, including asset and site-level data
* Excellent communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders

**Nice to have**

* Telecom DC power platforms such as Galaxy, Millennium, 596, Lorain, OmniOn/ABB and Vertiv

**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Manager, Core**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Director, Professional Services  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $100,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Core Implementation Manager (Core IM) is the sole owner of a portfolio of roughly 40+ First Due Core implementations, typically multi-module engagements. These standard and moderately complex projects carry real configuration complexity and frequently include CAD integration and historical data migration, requiring disciplined project management, strong customer command, and the ability to direct several internal specialists toward a single go-live date.

The Core IM owns the customer relationship and every project in the portfolio from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, and is accountable for planned duration, scope, risk, customer communication, and time to value. This is a fully autonomous role: you are self-directed on all delivery decisions inside the signed SOW and involve leadership only on commercial and relationship exceptions. Core delivery runs on a paired model: the Implementation Manager owns the project, the assigned Implementation Consultant owns module configuration and functional product depth, and Technical Services owns integration and data migration execution.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own a full portfolio of roughly 40+ concurrent Core implementations from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, consistently holding planned duration below team goal.
* Keep Rocketlane, the system of record, current always (plans, timelines, milestones, task status, owners, and dates) so any colleague can open a project and know exactly where it stands. Complete documentation and exit gates on time, not retroactively.
* Lead customer kickoffs with command: set clear expectations, correct unrealistic assumptions in the room, and close with an agreed action list, owners, and dates. Adapt the agenda to each agency’s politics and readiness based on Discovery.
* Run a progress cadence of at least bi-weekly check-ins on new acquisition projects and monthly on upsells, using each one to find and remove the real blocker rather than read status.
* Tailor each plan to the agency’s operational reality, including shift patterns, governance and approval cycles, budget calendars, and go-live blackout windows. Own multi-module sequencing, phasing, and dependency decisions across the platform.
* Direct and sequence the work of Implementation Consultants, Technical Services, Integrations, Support, and Product without direct authority, securing commitment on dates. Module configuration is owned by the assigned Implementation Consultant.
* Proactively surface product gaps, process gaps, communication silos, and methodology friction to leadership with supporting specifics and a proposed fix, and help own internal improvement efforts.

### **Qualifications:**

* This is a remote role, but the person hired must live in the US.
* 5+ years of experience managing customer-facing SaaS implementations (or 3+ years plus a master’s degree), including a portfolio of multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, including how fire, EMS, or law enforcement agencies operate and how decisions are made inside them.
* Demonstrated ownership of project plans, timelines, risk management, escalation recovery, and scope discipline, including change orders, on projects with multiple internal contributors.
* Proven ability to drive delivery outcomes through matrixed contributors without direct reporting authority.
* Working data literacy: comfortable reading record counts, spotting bad mappings, and assessing integration and migration risk.
* Experience with implementation project management tooling.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise, actionable follow-ups, status reporting an executive stakeholder can act on, and delivering bad news early with a recommended path.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working to billable utilization targets in a professional services organization.
* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management credential.
* Experience with fire, EMS, or law enforcement records management, CAD systems, or emergency services software.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce.
* Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment with evolving methodology and tooling.

**For US-based Roles**  
All applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer in the United States. Locality Media LLC is unable to sponsor or transition sponsorship ownership of employment visas at this time. Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the US, Locality Media participates in E-Verify.  
  
**Physical Demands and Work Environment**  
This role is fully remote with minimal travel expectations at this time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified employees and applicants to perform the essential functions as outlined above. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please reach out to people@firstdue.com.  
  
**Working at First Due**  
First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. This is a fully remote position open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate will help patients navigate appointments, referrals, follow-up care, and communication across providers while maintaining accurate documentation and protecting patient privacy.

This role is well suited for a clinically trained professional who is comfortable working independently, communicating through phone and digital platforms, and balancing multiple patient needs in a fast-moving healthcare environment. Part-time and full-time schedules are available.

Key responsibilities

* Coordinate patient care activities, referrals, appointments, follow-up services, and transitions between care settings.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for patients, caregivers, providers, and internal care teams.
* Conduct outreach to patients to confirm needs, review care plans, identify barriers, and support completion of next steps.
* Review clinical and administrative information to help identify gaps in care, missed follow-ups, or escalating needs.
* Document outreach, care coordination activities, referrals, and outcomes accurately in the EHR or care-management platform.
* Collaborate with physicians, nurses, case managers, social workers, and other members of the care team.
* Support patient education and reinforce care instructions within the scope of training, licensure, and established protocols.
* Escalate urgent, high-risk, or clinically significant concerns to the appropriate licensed clinician or supervisor.
* Track open items and follow through until the appropriate resolution, handoff, or patient connection is completed.
* Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA, organizational policies, and applicable federal and state requirements.
* Participate in virtual team meetings, quality-improvement activities, and process updates as needed.

Required qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in clinical care coordination, case management, nursing, patient navigation, utilization management, or a closely related healthcare role.
* RN or comparable healthcare education and experience.
* For roles involving nursing practice, an active, unrestricted RN license in the applicable state(s) is required. Candidates must be able to meet any state-specific licensure requirements associated with their assigned work.
* Experience working with an EHR/EMR, care-management platform, patient portal, or similar healthcare technology.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and empathetically.
* Excellent organization, prioritization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently from a home office while remaining responsive and collaborative with a remote team.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and the importance of maintaining confidential patient information.
* Reliable internet connection, private workspace, and ability to use a computer, headset, video-conferencing tools, and common productivity software.

Preferred qualifications

* BSN, MSN, or graduate degree in nursing, social work, public health, healthcare administration, or related field.
* Certifications such as CCM, ACM, CPHQ, or other relevant care management or quality credentials.
* Experience with chronic-care management, behavioral health, transitional care, population health, or value-based care.
* RN, LPN/LVN, or experienced Certified/Registered Medical Assistant, Clinical Care Coordinator – Medicare Care Management (APCM/CCM) - Examples may include an ADN or BSN with an active RN license, or a related degree/credential such as social work, public health, health administration, or allied health with substantial care-coordination experience.
* Experience supporting patients across multiple providers, payers, or healthcare settings.
* Bilingual or multilingual communication skills relevant to the patient population.

Success in this role looks like

* Patients understand their next steps and receive timely follow-ups.
* Referrals, appointments, and care transitions are tracked through completion.
* Documentation is accurate, complete, and entered promptly.
* Care-team members receive clear updates and escalations when needed.
* The coordinator consistently demonstrates empathy, sound judgment, and dependable follow-through.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Test Manager - Quality Assurance | United States | Fully Remote | Wednesday - Sunday
new_jobs.description:
**What we are looking for:**

  

**Important:** For this role we are only considering US-based candidates who are able & willing to work from Wednesday to Sunday every week.

  

We are seeking a highly motivated Test Manager to lead Quality Assurance for a AAA game development team. You will lead embedded testing teams, and partner with cross-functional leadership to balance quality, schedule, and risk in a complex development environment.

  

**What we will do together:**

  

QA Strategy & Leadership

* Define global QA strategy, test objectives, quality gates, and risk-based testing methodologies for major project milestones.
* Integrate QA into early development planning to ensure quality is a core part of the feature lifecycle rather than just final validation.

  

People Management

* Mentor and develop a high-performing team of QA Leads and testers, fostering a culture of ownership and collaboration.
* Manage both internal and external QA resources effectively to meet project demands.

  

Test Planning & Execution

* Oversee comprehensive test execution across functional, gameplay, performance, stability, multiplayer, and platform certification areas.
* Monitor defect trends and quality risks, ensuring critical issues are prioritized and driven to resolution.

  

Defect & Risk Management

* Analyze defect data to identify systemic quality issues and drive root-cause analysis and preventative initiatives.
* Communicate emerging quality risks and technical assessments clearly to Production and project leadership.

  

Milestone & Release Management

* Establish QA schedules and deliverables for major milestones, providing objective assessments of build stability and release readiness.
* Coordinate final regression and stabilization efforts during high-pressure release periods.

  

Platform Certification

* Lead preparation for first-party certification, coordinating test plans and tracking submission risks to ensure successful launches.

  

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Advocate for quality as the senior QA representative within project leadership, balancing technical standards with production constraints.
* Build strong partnerships across disciplines to establish a shared responsibility for quality across the entire development team.

  

External & Co-Development QA

* Manage external vendors and co-development QA teams, defining expectations and reporting standards to ensure seamless integration with internal strategy.

  

QA Tools, Metrics & Process Improvement

* Implement data-driven reporting and dashboards to track build health, test coverage, and milestone progress.
* Continuously improve QA efficiency through automation, tooling, and process retrospectives.

  

**What you will bring:**

* 7+ years in software QA with 3+ years managing teams in game development.
* Proven track record of shipping at least one major AAA title across the full development lifecycle.
* Expertise in developing test strategies, risk-based testing, and Agile methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership.

  

Nice to have

* Experience with Unreal audio features (e.g., Audio Mixer, MetaSounds, Sound Cues, Submixes, Quartz, spatialization plugins).
* Experience with platform-specific audio constraints and certification considerations.
* Experience building editor tools and pipeline automation.
* Experience supporting large-scale content teams and multi-project shared technology.
* Experience with console certification, multiplayer/online services, and live-service operations.
* Familiarity with Jira, TestRail, and technical QA solutions like automation and telemetry.

**Interested… a bit about Escape Velocity:**

Escape Velocity is a team of passionate, talented developers working at a studio that offers excellent benefits, on what we believe is a once-in-a-career project with a committed publisher. But that doesn't necessarily make us unique. What does make us special? We value the time, energy, and talent of our players and our colleagues. We want every hour spent developing and playing our games to be an incredibly rewarding and worthwhile use of your time. To that end, we are 'Fully Remote' and support team members nearly anywhere in the world. We prioritize honesty, even when that means sharing bad news. We strive to give everyone autonomy so they can determine how best to work and play, and we care more about what you bring to the game and studio than how many hours you're clocking. We're dedicated to building a culture of play, which not only makes us better game makers, but also strengthens the bonds between us all. We believe in constant improvement across all areas – from the game itself to our production design – and are constantly re-evaluating how we spend our time to ensure that we're not wasting yours and we're all always working on the most important things.

  

**A few benefits you can expect from us:**

* A generous PTO allowance

* Summer and Winter holidays studio closure (separate to PTO allowance)

* Private Medical & Dental Healthcare

* Private Mental Health scheme

* A generous annual Health & Wellbeing allowance

* Discretionary Studio Bonus

* Top range tech for your home set up

* Other benefits based on your region

  

**How to apply:**

Click apply and complete an application along with a Resume / CV. If we would like to move forward with your application, a member of the Recruiting Team will reach out to you and guide you through our process.

Escape Velocity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to hiring, promoting, and compensating employees based on their qualifications and demonstrated ability to perform job responsibilities.

Applications will be considered regardless of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, belief, race, or any other protected category.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager - US based only
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as an RCM Account Manager. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing client accounts, ensuring accurate and timely billing, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining strong client relationships. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in healthcare billing procedures, exceptional organizational skills, and a dedication to providing exceptional customer service.

### **About Heno INC**

HENO was founded by Jeff Hohman, a software engineer, and Katie Hohman, a physical therapist since 2006 and owner of three private practice clinics in Central Florida. When they opened their first clinic, the husband-and-wife team relied on four to five different software systems to manage their practice. This approach quickly proved inefficient and disorganized.

“For the first six months [using multiple platforms], we had no idea whether we were making or losing money,” Katie explained.

As their operations expanded to additional clinics, managing multiple systems became increasingly challenging. Determined to find a better solution, Jeff and Katie set out to develop a software that would simplify practice management and eliminate the chaos of using fragmented tools.

Drawing on Jeff's expertise in software engineering and Katie's hands-on experience managing clinics, they created HENO — the only EMR built by a physical therapist and private practice owner. This all-in-one platform is designed to save time, reduce costs, and streamline operations. By offering HENO to physical therapy practices everywhere, the Hohmans aim to empower clinicians to focus less on administrative tasks and more on what truly matters — the patient.

### **Description**

**Now Hiring: Medical Billing Account Manager**

**Join a fast-growing health tech company revolutionizing Physical Therapy billing!**

**Are you:**

* Enthusiastic and solution-oriented?
* A master of Physical Therapy Medical Billing?
* Seeking a role with real growth potential?
* Ready to prove your leadership and expertise?
* Ambitious and motivated to take your career to the next level?

If so, HENO may be the perfect fit for you.

**Who is HENO?**

**HENO is a rapidly expanding EMR and billing software platform serving Physical Therapy clinics nationwide. With our client base growing quickly and revenue doubling year-over-year, we’re seeking a talented and driven** **Medical Billing Account Manager** **to help elevate our client service experience and support continued growth.**

**Role Overview:**

**As a Medical Billing Account Manager, you’ll be a critical leader in our billing service division. You will oversee billing team operations, ensure quality and timeliness of service, and act as the main liaison between HENO and our valued PT clinic clients.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Monitor PT clinic billing accounts daily to identify and resolve incomplete or incorrect work.
* Coordinate with onboarding to ensure seamless setup for new clients—ensuring no disruption to their cash flow.
* Maintain consistent communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and resolve issues promptly.
* Supervise daily tasks including claims processing, rejection and denial resolution, payment posting, and patient statement delivery.
* Perform quality checks on billing team outputs and ensure all errors are corrected.
* Develop internal SOPs, guides, and checklists to streamline services.
* Train the billing team on best practices for client communication.
* Analyze reports to identify trends, inefficiencies, or potential problems.
* Provide feedback and feature suggestions to management and the product development team.

**What You Bring:**

  

* 3–5 years’ experience in Physical Therapy Medical Billing.
* 3–5 years’ experience working in a billing service environment.
* Proven experience communicating directly with medical clinic clients.
* Strong skills in managing rejections, denials, and overdue claims.
* Experience acting as a liaison between internal billing staff and clients.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) preferred, but not required.

**What you'll do**

* Apply Epic Clarity and professional/physician billing (PB) knowledge to identify trends and improvement opportunities across charge capture, coding, claim edits, and denials

* Track follow-up actions and support execution against recommendations

new_jobs.description:
**Job Requisition No**

VN8514

  

**Work Location Name**

USA - Remote

  

**Worker Basis**

Full Time

  

**Worker Type**

Employee

  

**Contract Type**

Permanent

  

**Applications Close Date**

Dec 31, 2026

  

**Purpose**

As an **Account Manager – New Jersey**, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding BVI’s presence across the assigned territory. You will develop and maintain strong relationships with ophthalmic surgeons, clinical teams, and healthcare organizations while identifying opportunities to introduce and expand BVI’s portfolio. The role combines strategic territory management, consultative selling, clinical product support, and new business development across hospitals, ASCs, and private practice settings.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a territory strategy to achieve and exceed assigned sales targets across New Jersey.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with ophthalmic surgeons, clinical staff, purchasing teams, and other key decision-makers.
* Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities while expanding BVI’s presence within existing accounts.
* Promote BVI’s ophthalmic portfolio by communicating the clinical and commercial value of products to customers and end users.
* Provide product demonstrations and clinical support within customer facilities, including operating room environments where appropriate.
* Analyze territory performance, customer activity, sales data, and competitive intelligence to prioritize opportunities and guide account strategy.
* Use CRM and other sales tools to effectively plan customer interactions, document activities, track opportunities, and maintain accurate account information.
* Partner with Marketing, Clinical Affairs, Customer Service, Operations, and other BVI teams to deliver an effective customer experience and identify opportunities to expand the BVI portfolio.

  

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of successful sales experience within healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or a related industry.
* Experience selling to healthcare professionals, hospitals, ASCs, physician practices, or other healthcare organizations.
* Ophthalmology experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience working with surgical products or technologies.
* Demonstrated success in developing new business while growing and retaining existing customer accounts.
* Strong consultative selling, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with surgeons, clinical staff, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to analyze sales data, manage territory priorities, and use CRM and other sales tools to drive effective account strategies.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout New Jersey, including occasional overnight travel, and to work in clinical and operating-room environments as required.

  

**Company**

BVI® is refocusing the future of vision.
  
  
As one of the fastest-growing, diversified surgical ophthalmic businesses in the world, our purpose-built portfolio of trusted brands includes: Beaver® (Knives and Blades), Visitec® (Cannulas), Malosa® (Single-Use Instruments), Vitreq® (Vitreoretinal Surgical Products) and PhysIOL® (Premium IOLs), and spans more than 90 countries.
  
  
We’ve set our sights on touching the lives of millions of patients affected by conditions such as cataracts, refractive error, glaucoma, retinal disease, and dry eye. Unburdened by legacy or bureaucracy, we have developed our strategy around a simple concept – taking pride in delivering innovative solutions for our physicians and patients, based on their needs. We trust and empower our associates to make decisions and solve problems because collaboration drives us. Valuing agility, simplicity, and transparency, we stay committed to listening to our customers, delivering for our patients, and keeping the future in focus.
  
  
Learn more at www.bvimedical.com

new_jobs.description:
Changing lives. Building Careers.

Joining us is a chance to do important work that creates change and shapes the future of healthcare. Thinking differently is what we do best. To us, change equals opportunity. Every day, our colleagues are challenging what’s possible and making headway to innovate new treatment pathways to advance patient outcomes and set new standards of care.

The Wound Reconstruction Solutions Account Manager will be a responsible for Integra’s Integra Skin, PriMatrix and OmniGraft, product lines and solely responsible for supporting the sales of these products for a defined territory within the Hospital OR/Surgery and post-acute wound care setting. * Work with peers when called up to support case coverage and inventory requests
* Take initiative to identify new business opportunities
* Identify product improvement opportunities for sales, marketing and product development teams.
* Maintain high level of technical, product and disease state knowledge
* Provide a consultative role in the OR environment in accordance with specific product indications
* Operate within defined budgets and strictly with in accordance with Corporate policies and procedures
* Strictly adhere to the policies and procedures within the Advamed Code of Conduct and the Sunshine Act
* Perform sales administrative duties in a timely manner and as defined by management.

* Minimum of 4 years of professional and/or related experience is required.
* **Candidate must be local to Scottsdale**
* Prior experience working in an operating room environment is required.
* Valid driver's license issued in the United States
* Willing and able to work outside of normal business hours
* Ability to travel on occasional weekends and/or overnight travel.
* Residence in or the ability to relocate to the posted territory
* Strong technical product knowledge of surgical instruments, procedures, protocols and solutions
* Strong interpersonal communication, influencing, critical thinking and problem-solving skills required.

* Available before and after traditional work hours (9-5)

**Job Summary**

The Capital Planning & Stress Testing Program Manager leads Flagstar’s stress testing and capital planning processes, reporting to the Director of Capital Planning & Stress Testing. This role coordinates cross-functional teams to execute stress test plans, ensure regulatory compliance, and align with capital management policies. Responsibilities include developing and integrating stress testing processes, overseeing documentation, guiding scenario design, and preparing reports for senior management and regulators. The manager ensures that capital planning is effective, meets governance standards, and supports strategic decisions. This role exists to ensure the bank’s capital planning exercises are executed efficiently, meet regulatory expectations, and support sound strategic decision-making.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Program Leadership & Plan Coordination: Leads the bank’s stress testing program, coordinating input from multiple departments to collect and integrate all necessary data and materials. Maintains and updates key capital planning documents (e.g., capital plan narrative, policies, contingency plans) to ensure the stress testing process is cohesive and aligned with business objectives.
* Scenario Design & Challenge Oversight: Leads internal stress test scenarios informed by the bank’s idiosyncratic risks (Risk ID inventory) and evaluates capital adequacy under adverse conditions. Manages review/challenge sessions on forecasted results (e.g., PPNR, credit losses), addressing key assumptions and limitations through sensitivity analysis and appropriate overlays.
* Reporting & Regulatory Submission: Prepares and submits regulatory stress testing reports and the final capital plan document, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Produces clear summaries of stress test results and recommended capital actions for senior management and Board review and performs ad-hoc capital analyses (such as peer comparisons) to support decision-making.

Maintains an inventory of critical capital planning data elements, working with Data Governance to resolve data issues, and verifies adherence to internal risk management standards. * Strategic Alignment: Works under the direction of the CPST Director to ensure that stress testing activities support the bank’s strategic goals for capital adequacy and risk management. Provides input to senior leadership on opportunities to improve capital efficiency or risk mitigation based on stress test insights.

* Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
* Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

***Role summary***

We are hiring a part-time Sales & Operations Leader to run the sales and operations staff across three businesses: BICS (IT and analytics consulting), Evolve (digital marketing), and S&N Investment Properties (real estate). The people doing the work are already in place; this Leader keeps them on process, verifies execution, and drives revenue, close rate, and customer engagement heading into 2027.

***Job responsibilities***

· **Strategic execution:** Translate founder and leadership ideas into a defined objective, owner, next step, timeline, and practical measure of progress. Surface trade-offs when priorities change.

· **Sales leadership and revenue operations:** Review HubSpot visibility, opportunity ownership, follow-up and stalled deals. Join selected sales calls to observe performance, give specific feedback, coach the sales team, and improve discovery and handoffs. The assigned salesperson remains accountable for the call and follow-up.

· **Marketing and outreach:** Drive marketing and outreach to existing BICS and Evolve clients and selected prospects. With no dedicated marketing team, define the audience, offer, message, channels, and next steps; personally build or coordinate the materials and campaigns; and assess what generates useful conversations.

· **RFP and proposal leadership:** Review RFPs for fit, requirements, credibility and quality. Serve as the point person gathering relevant project examples, results, references, technical input and other source material from delivery and leadership so proposals are sufficiently supported. Coordinate revisions with the proposal writer and pursuit owner.

· **Cross-company coordination:** Connect people and decisions across BICS and Evolve when an initiative spans sales, marketing, delivery, finance, or administration. Identify work without a clear owner.

· **Onboarding and handoffs:** Coordinate the operational pieces of new team member and client onboarding, including access, documentation, role expectations and handoffs to the assigned owners. Confirm that outstanding setup steps have an owner and are completed.

· **Operational blocker resolution:** Act as the liaison among administrative, accounting, IT, and other support staff to identify and resolve blockers. Bring the founder a concise decision or escalation when the issue exceeds the role’s authority or available resources.

· **Client engagement:** Maintain direct contact with clients when an introduction, relationship check-in, service concern, expansion conversation, or cross-team coordination would help move work forward. Bring the appropriate sales or delivery owner into follow-up.

· **Operational improvement:** Assess workflows, staffing arrangements, tools, AI, and automation opportunities. Move approved changes into use with an owner, basic validation, and follow-through.

· **Delivery and PM enablement:** Partner with delivery leadership to strengthen handoffs, project visibility, and practical PM standards without creating a large training burden. Delivery leadership retains project and PM management.

***Required traits and skills***

· **Hands-on:** Willing and able to do the work, learn unfamiliar technology, and build new tools or solutions when the business needs them.

· **Comfort with ambiguity:** Works from incomplete context, asks targeted questions, checks assumptions, and brings back a concrete recommendation rather than waiting for a complete brief.

· **Independent judgment and resilience:** Makes practical decisions with incomplete information, explains the reasoning, and remains steady when feedback changes the direction. Adjusts and keeps work moving without relying on the founder for every next step.

· **Commercial and technical fluency:** Understands a small technology services firm well enough to connect client needs, delivery capacity, proposals, CRM activity, and profitability. Deep engineering expertise is unnecessary.

· **Independent follow-through:** Tracks commitments, closes loops across contractors and teams, escalates blockers early, and adapts when circumstances change.

· **Pragmatic systems judgment:** Uses lightweight routines and selective automation to improve reliability without imposing unnecessary meetings, documentation, or software.

Pay: $50.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
TECHNICAL OPERATIONS LEAD (WEB OPERATIONS & SECURITY)  
Fractional · Fully remote

ABOUT THE ROLE

You keep every website merabi touches online, secure, fast, and correctly configured, and you catch problems before our clients or we do. You also implement our SEO and AI visibility specifications on those sites. You do not set that strategy.

About 70% of this role is infrastructure, security, and development. The rest is implementing search and AI visibility work. If you are an SEO specialist who does some server work, this is not your role. If you are a backend or web operations person who understands how search and AI crawlers read a site, it is.

merabi is a B2B content marketing agency. We manage websites for clients across several industries. Our stack is WordPress (WPBakery, Salient, Yoast), WP Engine, Google Search Console and GA4, ClickUp, and Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Primary: keeping sites running and secure

* Uptime and error monitoring, spotting problems before clients report them
* Security: hosting and cloud hardening, access control, plugin vulnerability management, malware remediation, recovery after a compromise
* Maintenance: core, theme and plugin updates, backups and restore testing, staging environments, Core Web Vitals
* Development: new client site builds, ongoing changes and fixes on live sites
* Incident response: you are the person who fixes it when a site goes down, gets hacked, or breaks after an update
* Internal IT: tooling, access management, credential hygiene across a small remote team

Secondary: implementing our search and AI visibility specifications

* Google Search Console across client properties: index coverage, sitemaps, crawl errors
* Site hygiene: redirects, canonicals, broken links, making sure every page resolves and indexes as intended
* Structured data: deploying the JSON-LD we specify, validating it, fixing what fails
* AI visibility: robots.txt permissions for AI crawlers, verifying pages render for them, monitoring AI referral traffic

We write the SEO, GEO and AEO strategy in house. You implement it, tell us when something we’ve specified won’t work technically, and confirm it is live.

REQUIREMENTS

* Hands-on professional WordPress administration: hosting, staging, migrations, updates, backups, plugin conflicts
* Web and server security: hardening, access control, malware cleanup, recovery from a compromised site
* Development capable of new builds, not just maintenance
* Comfortable owning incident response, including the judgment to escalate versus fix quietly
* Working proficiency in Google Search Console
* Able to read a specification, implement it exactly, and confirm it worked

Working knowledge is enough:

* How indexing, canonicalization and redirects affect search visibility
* Schema and JSON-LD: deploying and validating it, following our strategy
* How AI crawlers and AI search surfaces read a site, and what blocks them
* Core Web Vitals and page performance

Nice to have: SEO strategy, keyword research, copywriting, client-facing account management.

WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GREAT IN THIS ROLE

* You catch things before we do. The single most valuable trait here is noticing a problem on a client site before the client or we notice it.
* You document what you change.
* You are direct about what is broken, including when we are the ones who broke it.

THE ENGAGEMENT

* Fractional, ongoing monthly retainer. Not a project, not full-time employment.
* Starting at 20 hours per month, scaling to 30 or 40 as our client roster grows
* Up to 10 additional hours per month for incidents and unplanned work, approved in advance, billed only when used
* First month around 45 hours, to complete the site inventory and security baseline
* New client website builds and major rebuilds sit outside the retainer and are scoped and quoted per project
* Rate: tell us your hourly rate when you apply
* Fully remote
* Reachable for critical incidents outside normal hours. We are not asking for 24/7 on-call, but a client site down over a weekend needs a response.
* You work directly with Jessica, and with Ana, who handles technical implementation on the content side

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

* Inventory every site we manage: hosting, access, backup status, plugin and update state, known issues
* Apply a security baseline across the portfolio: access control, tested backups, known vulnerabilities closed
* Document an incident response path with agreed response times
* Clear Search Console across all properties: no unresolved index coverage or redirect errors
* Implement and verify our AI visibility specifications on every site

TO APPLY

Email jessica@merabi.co with:

* A short note on a site you inherited in bad shape and what you did about it
* Your hourly rate and your availability per month
* Links or references for work we can look at, or a client who will vouch for how you handle an emergency

Pay: $25.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* IT support: 3 years (Required)
* Web development: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
